declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData},
  S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
    S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
      (∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
        (∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
          (∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
            (∀ (n : ℤ),
                S.curlAbsorb n =
                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
              (∀ (n : ℤ),
                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                    else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                (∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                  (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                      S.symWeight n j l =
                        S.energyWeight n *
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                K.angularWeight n *
                                  max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^ 2) -
                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                          S.tailShift n) →
                    (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                        S.antiWeight n j l =
                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                      max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^ 2) -
                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                            S.tailShift n) →
                      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                          S.velWeight n j l =
                            (S.tailShift n *
                                if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                              S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W

declarations.type:
∀ {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} {resolved : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)}
  {coef : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ × ℝ → Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients} {ch : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges}
  {T : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.LeafValues},
  (∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 < T.hessFloor ι) →
    (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.hessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).hess) →
      (∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 ≤ T.curlHessFloor ι) →
        (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.curlHessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).curlHess) →
          (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, (T.localMatrix ι p).IsHermitian) →
            (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => T.localMatrix ι p i j) ∧
                  ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖T.localMatrix ι p i j‖ ≤ C) →
              (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                    ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.coefPairValue (coef ι p) s v - T.boxPenalty ι s v) →
                (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                          0 ≤
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) -
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss (ch.curl ι p) (ch.product ι p)
                                      (ch.gradient ι p) (ch.length ι p) s v -
                                  T.boxPairPenalty ι s v) +
                              T.absorbValue ι s v) →
                  (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p ∧ 0 < ch.length ι p) →
                    (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                        T.hessFloor (-ι) = T.hessFloor ι ∧
                          T.curlHessFloor (-ι) = T.curlHessFloor ι ∧
                            T.curlAbsorb (-ι) = T.curlAbsorb ι ∧
                              T.strainAbsorb (-ι) = T.strainAbsorb ι ∧ T.velocityAbsorb (-ι) = T.velocityAbsorb ι) →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsLeafValues K resolved coef ch T

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
    (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤ h.ampGradW β y) →
      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
              h.ampVort β y) →
        (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                h.ampGradVort β y) →
          (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
            (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supGradVort y) →
              (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                  ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                        (m.epsP β).frame •
                          (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                            (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                    (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                          (m.muP β).frame •
                            (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                              (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                      (m.muP β).speed y) →
                  (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                      ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                        ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                          (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^ 2 ≤
                            ratio *
                              ∑ β,
                                |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                  (m.muP β).wt y) →
                        0 ≤ ratio →
                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space), m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup
                                  ratio

                (profile_divergence :
                    ∀ q ∈ d.params, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (d.profile q σ) y = 0) →
                  (profile_decay :
                      ∀ q ∈ d.params,

                            ‖fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ) y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                              ‖d.profileSecondDeriv q σ y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3) →
                    (profileSecondDeriv_measurable :
                        ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.profileSecondDeriv q z.1 z.2)
                            MeasureTheory.volume) →
                      (profileSecondDeriv_periodic :
                          ∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profileSecondDeriv q)) →
                        (profileSecondDeriv_weak :
                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),

                                  (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                                  (d.profileSecondDeriv q σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                          (profile_invariant :
                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                ∀ γ ∈ d.symmetries,
                                  ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    d.profile q (σ + γ.2) (γ.1 y) = γ.1 (d.profile q σ y)) →
                            (pressureGrad_measurable :

                                    MeasureTheory.volume) →

                                      ∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                        Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestField φ →
                                          ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (d.pressureGrad q z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2) =
                                            0) →
                                  (adjoint_measurable :
                                      ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                        ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.adjoint j q z.1 z.2)
                                            MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                    (adjoint_periodic :

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsExteriorCondition.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {mc : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges} {mm : ℕ}
  {E : Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.ExteriorCondition C nE nM},
  E.pieces.IsValidOn m P h mm E.modes E.region →
    ((∃ R R₀ R₁,
          Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsDirectionRadius R R₀ R₁ ∧
            E.region = Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeRayRegion R ∧
              E.inverseSquareConst ≤ Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.rayInverseSquareConst E.pieces.azimuthLow) ∨
        ∃ R,
          0 < R ∧
            E.region = Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeSquareExterior R ∧
              E.inverseSquareConst ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ ι ∈ E.modes, Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth mm ι = 0) →
      0 < E.inverseSquareConst →
        E.charges.Covers mc E.modes E.region →
          (∀ p ∈ E.region, 0 ≤ (E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).hess) →
            (∀ p ∈ E.region,
                E.gradLow ≤ ((E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).charged E.charges p).gradFloor E.pieces.azimuthLow p.1) →
              (∀ p ∈ E.region,
                  Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeRadius p ^ 2 *
                      max (-((E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).charged E.charges p).vel) 0 ≤
                    E.velHigh) →
                (∀ p ∈ E.region,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeRadius p * ((E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).charged E.charges p).cross ≤
                      E.crossHigh) →
                  0 ≤ E.velHigh →
                    0 ≤ E.crossHigh →
                      E.velHigh / E.inverseSquareConst + E.crossHigh / √E.inverseSquareConst ≤ E.gradLow →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsExteriorCondition m P h w mc mm E

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure.casesOn
declarations.type:
{A B : Type} →
  [inst : Fintype A] →
    [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
      {T : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.SignedTree A B} →
        {ν : T.Node} →
          {D : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ComplexNodeData A B} →
            {E F : Matrix D.Index D.Index ℝ} →
              {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure T ν D E F → Sort u} →
                (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure T ν D E F) →
                  ((coordinates : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.IsCoordinateOn D.coords D.pivot) →
                      (factor_nonneg : 0 ≤ D.factor) →
                        (input_self_adjoint : D.input.conjTranspose = D.input) →
                          (base_self_adjoint : D.base.conjTranspose = D.base) →
                            (weight_pos : ∀ (j : D.Index), 0 < D.weight j) →
                              (input_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ E i j) →
                                (input_error_symm : E.transpose = E) →
                                  (front_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                                    (front_error_symm : F.transpose = F) →
                                      (row_bound :
                                          ∀ (i : D.Index),
                                            D.weight i *
                                                ∑ j,
                                                  (‖Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexSlackRemainder D.input D.base
                                                            D.pivot D.pivotValue D.posColumns D.negColumns i j‖ +
                                                        E i j +
                                                      F i j) /
                                                    D.weight j ≤
                                              D.radius i) →
                                        (input_lower :
                                            ∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                                  (D.factor •
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix
                                                      D.input)
                                                  x ≤
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x +
                                                  D.factor *
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i =>
                                                      ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec
                                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                                          (front_upper :
                                              ∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                                      (D.factor •
                                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix
                                                          (D.base -
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexDiagonal
                                                              (Finset.univ \ D.pivot) D.radius))
                                                      x +
                                                    D.factor *
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i =>
                                                        ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec
                                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                                            (pivots_eq : T.pivots ν = D.coords.pivotImage D.pivot) →
                                              (slack_le :
                                                  ∀ k ∈ T.pivots ν,
                                                    T.slack ν k ≤
                                                      D.factor *
                                                        D.coords.slackOn D.pivot (fun j => D.pivotValue j - D.radius j)
                                                          k) →
                                                (columns :
                                                    ∃ e,
                                                      Function.Injective e ∧
                                                        ∀ (c : D.Neg ⊕ D.Neg),
                                                          T.columnNode (e c) = ν ∧
                                                            T.column (e c) =
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realColumns D.coords.matrix
                                                                D.factor D.negColumns c) →
                                                  motive ⋯) →
                    motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.mk.sizeOf_spec
declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace X]
  [inst_3 : SizeOf X] (F : Breakdown.MildFramework X) (rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X)
  (rot_commutes : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R))
  (embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X)
  (embed_sub :
    ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g)
  (embed_norm :
    ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
        ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2)
  (embed_ne_zero : ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0)
  (embed_rot :
    ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f))
  (embed_dilate :
    ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      0 < μ → Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f))
  (mild_of_weak :
    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
      a < b →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2) (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b))
                    (nhds 0)) →
                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ - Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ) t) →
                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ → ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                    F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b)
  (test : Submodule ℝ X) (test_dense : Dense ↑test)
  (test_spec : ∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x),
  sizeOf
      { F := F, rot := rot, rot_commutes := rot_commutes, embed := embed, embed_sub := embed_sub,
        embed_norm := embed_norm, embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero, embed_rot := embed_rot, embed_dilate := embed_dilate,
        mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak, test := test, test_dense := test_dense, test_spec := test_spec } =
    1 + sizeOf F + sizeOf test

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k},
  (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
    0 ≤ d.stiffRadius →
      (∀ (j : Fin k), d.scale j ≠ 0) →
        d.weight ≤ d.weightMax →
          0 < d.multiplierWeight →
            0 ≤ d.coerciveL2 →
              0 ≤ d.coercivePin →
                0 ≤ d.rowBound →
                  0 ≤ d.gapSize →
                    0 ≤ d.formShift →
                      d.transferLoss < 1 →
                        d.coerciveL2 + d.rowBound ≤ (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.coerciveTotal →
                          0 < d.coerciveTotal →
                            0 ≤ d.actuatorBound →
                              0 ≤ d.modelFormBound →
                                d.modelFormBound + d.formShift ≤ d.formBound →
                                  0 ≤ d.sizeBound →
                                    0 < d.supBound →
                                      (∀ q ∈ d.params, d.period q ≤ d.periodMax) →
                                        0 < d.twist →
                                          (d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                            (∑ i, Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖d.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                ENNReal.ofReal (d.actuatorBound ^ 2) →
                                              (∀ q ∈ d.params, 0 ≤ d.defectBound q ∧ 0 ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖d.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                      ENNReal.ofReal (d.defectBound q ^ 2)) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ d.params, d.rows (d.defect q) ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                    (∀ q ∈ d.params, d.defectBound q ≤ d.defectMax) →
                                                      (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                          d.coerciveL2 * d.defectBound q + d.defectRowBound q +
                                                              d.coercivePin * Breakdown.vecNorm (d.targetGap q) ≤
                                                            (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.sizeBound) →
                                                        2 * d.coerciveTotal * Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                              d.supBound <
                                                            1 →
                                                          4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 *
                                                                (1 / d.weight +
                                                                      2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.formBound +
                                                                    2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                      (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) +
                                                                  2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) / d.coerciveTotal) ≤
                                                              d.supBound ^ 2 →
                                                            4 *
                                                                      (1 / d.weight +
                                                                        2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.formBound) *
                                                                    d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                  4 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.sizeBound *
                                                                    (d.defectMax +
                                                                        2 * Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                            d.sizeBound *
                                                                          d.supBound +
                                                                      2 * (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) *
                                                                        d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                d.supBound ^ 2 →
                                                              IsUnit d.frame →
                                                                (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                    ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                      ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                                                        ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            ENNReal.ofReal (‖d.adjoint j q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                          ENNReal.ofReal (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →
                                                                  (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointL2 j) →
                                                                    (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                                      (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j) →
                                                                        (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                              d.adjointQuad j * (2 * d.sizeBound) ^ 2 +
                                                                                    2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                      √(d.adjointDefect j ^ 2 +
                                                                                          (Breakdown.vecNorm
                                                                                                (d.actuatorAdjointError
                                                                                                  q j) /
                                                                                              d.multiplierWeight) ^
                                                                                            2) +
                                                                                  d.adjointOffset j ≤
                                                                                |d.scale j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                          0 ≤ d.stiffNorm →
                                                                            (∀ (x : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                                                ∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                    (∑ i, d.frame i j * x i) ^ 2 ≤
                                                                                  d.stiffNorm ^ 2 * ∑ i, x i ^ 2) →
                                                                              (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                  √(∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                        (∑ i,
                                                                                              d.frame i j *
                                                                                                d.multiplier q i -
                                                                                            d.scale j * q j) ^
                                                                                          2) ≤
                                                                                    d.stiffOffset) →
                                                                                2 * d.sizeBound * d.stiffNorm /
                                                                                        d.multiplierWeight +
                                                                                      d.stiffOffset ≤
                                                                                    d.stiffRadius →
                                                                                  (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                      4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 / d.weight <
                                                                                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral
                                                                                            fun σ y =>
                                                                                            Breakdown.matSq
                                                                                              (fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ)
                                                                                                y)).toReal) →
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.CertificateClauses
                                                                                      d

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
    (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤ h.ampGradW β y) →
      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
              h.ampVort β y) →
        (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                h.ampGradVort β y) →
          (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
            (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supGradVort y) →
              (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                  ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                        (m.epsP β).frame •
                          (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                            (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                    (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                          (m.muP β).frame •
                            (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                              (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                      (m.muP β).speed y) →
                  (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                      ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                        ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                          (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^ 2 ≤
                            ratio *
                              ∑ β,
                                |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                  (m.muP β).wt y) →
                        0 ≤ ratio →
                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space), m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup
                                  ratio

    (∀ i ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ, d.scale i ≠ 0 ∧ |d.stiffRadius| ≤ |d.scale i| * r.coordBound i) →
      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms r.centrePotential r.centreNumbers →
        (∀ q ∈ d.params,
            Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
              (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.centreResidual q) r.pinFlux r.centrePotential)
              r.centreNumbers.remainder) →
          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet, Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms (r.fittedPotential i) (r.fittedNumbers i)) →
            (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet,
                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.fittedResidual i) (fun x x_1 => 0)
                    (r.fittedPotential i))
                  (r.fittedNumbers i).remainder) →
              (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, 0 < r.freeWeight i) →
                0 ≤ r.freeValue →
                  0 ≤ r.freeDual →
                    (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                            (∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * ‖r.free q i σ y‖ ^ 2) * ‖r.field σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                          ENNReal.ofReal (r.freeValue ^ 2)) →
                      (∃ δ,
                          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ,
                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                                  (fun σ y =>
                                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.transposeApply (fderiv ℝ (r.free q i σ) y) (r.field σ y))
                                  (δ i)) ∧
                            ∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * δ i ^ 2 ≤ r.freeDual ^ 2) →
                        Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative r.field)
                            r.timeDual →
                          0 ≤ r.pinError →
                            0 ≤ r.pinRound →
                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                    ‖∑ l, r.pinCoef l • (r.pins.potential l σ y - r.pins.generator l σ y)‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                  ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinError ^ 2) →
                                (∀ (c : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                        Breakdown.matSq
                                          (∑ l, c l • (d.pin l σ y - fderiv ℝ (r.pins.potential l σ) y))) ≤
                                      ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinRound ^ 2 * ∑ l, c l ^ 2)) →
                                  √(∑ l, r.pinCoef l ^ 2) ≤ r.pinCoefNorm →
                                    r.defectSum d.weight + r.pinCharge d.weight ≤ d.adjointDefect j →
                                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded d j r

                      (pinFieldLoss_bound :
                          ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤

                                        0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss) →
                          (potLoss_ge :
                              c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  L.order = c.order →
    L.box = K →
      L.bases = B →
        L.modes = S.resolved →
          L.degCoef = S.degHigh →
            L.degSide = S.degLow →
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B →
                  (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                    (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧ L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo →
                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                            (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                              ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                          (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                              ((L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                            (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                  ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧ (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                              (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                  (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                    (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                    L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                      L.corner c =
                                        if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                          ((L.segment s).level, if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                        else
                                          (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi, (L.segment s).level)) →
                                  (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                      L.segEnd s e = none →
                                        ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                    (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                        (L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                        1 ≤ L.degSide →
                                          L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef →
                                            (∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                  L.corner c =
                                                    (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂, if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                              (∀ (i j : Fin 2), L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                    ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                      ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                        (L.segment s).level =
                                                          if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                          else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                  (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                      (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                        ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                          (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                            else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                            ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                              (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                    (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                        ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                          ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                            s ≠ s' →
                                                              (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                (L.segment s').hi ≤ (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount), ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                            d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                              d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                    (L.segment s).test d u * (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                  if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions.rec
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R} →
              {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S → Sort u} →
                  ((cell_conditions : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R) →
                      (row_map :
                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount)
                            (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                            S K x →
                              (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
                                (∑ ι,
                                      if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                                        ∑ d,
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                                              (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                                              (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                                      else 0) +
                                    ∑ ι',
                                      ∑ d,
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K
                                              ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K
                                              ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
                                  ∑ l,
                                    x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                        ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                        (row_band :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                              ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                  (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p =
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
                          (row_tail :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                                      (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                                        ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                                          (D.mesh.box K).proj
                                            (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                            else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                            (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                            else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                            (fun p' =>
                                              ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                                            p) →
                            (partners_leak :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                  (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                              (leak_curl :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                      ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                            ∑ g,
                                              if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2
                                              else 0) +
                                          if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                            2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                              2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                                          else 0) ≤
                                        (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
                                (leak_vel :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                        ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                              ∑ g,
                                                if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then
                                                  (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2
                                                else 0) +
                                            if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                  ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                  (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                                            else 0) ≤
                                          (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                                  (tests_valid :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                                            (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                                              (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                  ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)

                          ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤

                                  0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                                    0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                                      0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧
                                        0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss) →

                              c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +
                                  c.actuatorGradLoss / (2 * c.multiplierScale * √c.weightMin) ≤
                                c.potLoss) →

                                    c.actuatorLoss / c.multiplierScale ≤

                                                            ∑ i,

                                      (gauge_valid :
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧
                                            L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo) →
                                        (segment_on_side :
                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                              (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧
                                                      (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                                                ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                                    K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                                          (segment_other_in_box :
                                              ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                                  (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                                            (corner_is_corner :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                  ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧
                                                      (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                                              (corner_other :
                                                  ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                    (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                                      (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →

                                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                      L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                                        L.corner c =
                                                          if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                                            ((L.segment s).level,
                                                              if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                                          else
                                                            (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi,
                                                              (L.segment s).level)) →
                                                  (segEnd_axis :
                                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                                        L.segEnd s e = none →
                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →

                                                          (L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (height_test_affine :
                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),

                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                                (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →

                                                                  ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                    L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →

                                                                          (L.segment s).level =

                                                                            else
                                                                              if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂
                                                                              else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                                  (sideSegments_cover :
                                                                      ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                        (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                                          ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                                            (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                                              else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                                              ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                                (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧
                                                                                  u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                                    (sideSegments_disjoint :
                                                                        ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                          ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                            ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                              s ≠ s' →

                                                                      (segments_on_sides :

                                                                        (segment_orthonormal :

        (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.testOf a < R.testCount (R.cellOf a) (R.labelOf a)) →
          (∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
              R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b →
                R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b → R.testOf a = R.testOf b → R.realPart a = R.realPart b → a = b) →
            (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, 0 < R.testWeight K ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K ι ≤ tauMax) →
                (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K (-ι) = R.testWeight K ι) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                        R.testCount K (-ι) = R.testCount K ι ∧
                          ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                            ∀ (c : Fin 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K (-ι) i c) p =
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K ι i c) p)) →
                    (∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                        R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b → R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf b → R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf a → R.realPart a = true) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                              ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                                ∀ (part : Bool),
                                  (ι = -ι → part = true) →
                                    ∃ a,
                                      R.cellOf a = K ∧
                                        (R.labelOf a = ι ∨ R.labelOf a = -ι) ∧ R.testOf a = i ∧ R.realPart a = part) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              ↑p.1 * deriv (fun r => R.testValue M.box a 0 (r, p.2)) p.1 + R.testValue M.box a 0 p +
                                    Complex.I * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth m (R.labelOf a)) *
                                      R.testValue M.box a 1 p +
                                  ↑p.1 * deriv (fun z => R.testValue M.box a 2 (p.1, z)) p.2 =
                                0) →
                            (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                (M.box (R.cellOf a)).IsAxis →
                                  p.1 = 0 → R.testValue M.box a 0 p = 0 ∧ R.testValue M.box a 1 p = 0) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, (R.testBlockMatrix M.box K ι).PosDef) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.mk.inj
declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {inst : NormedAddCommGroup X} {inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X} {inst_2 : CompleteSpace X}
  {F : Breakdown.MildFramework X} {rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X}
  {rot_commutes : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R)}
  {embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X}
  {embed_sub :
    ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g}
  {embed_norm :
    ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
        ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2}
  {embed_ne_zero : ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0}
  {embed_rot :
    ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)}
  {embed_dilate :
    ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      0 < μ → Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)}
  {mild_of_weak :
    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
      a < b →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2) (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b))
                    (nhds 0)) →
                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ - Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ) t) →
                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ → ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                    F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b}
  {test : Submodule ℝ X} {test_dense : Dense ↑test} {test_spec : ∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x}
  {F_1 : Breakdown.MildFramework X} {rot_1 : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X}
  {rot_commutes_1 : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F_1.Commutes (rot_1 R)}
  {embed_1 : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X}
  {embed_sub_1 :
    ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed_1 (f - g) = embed_1 f - embed_1 g}
  {embed_norm_1 :
    ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
        ‖embed_1 f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2}
  {embed_ne_zero_1 :
    ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed_1 f ≠ 0}
  {embed_rot_1 :
    ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot_1 R) (embed_1 f) = embed_1 (Breakdown.pushForward R f)}
  {embed_dilate_1 :
    ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      0 < μ → Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F_1.D μ) (embed_1 f) = embed_1 (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)}
  {mild_of_weak_1 :
    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
      a < b →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed_1 (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2) (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b))
                    (nhds 0)) →
                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ - Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ) t) →
                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ → ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                    F_1.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed_1 (v t)) a b}
  {test_1 : Submodule ℝ X} {test_dense_1 : Dense ↑test_1}
  {test_spec_1 : ∀ x ∈ test_1, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed_1 φ = x},
  { F := F, rot := rot, rot_commutes := rot_commutes, embed := embed, embed_sub := embed_sub, embed_norm := embed_norm,
        embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero, embed_rot := embed_rot, embed_dilate := embed_dilate,
        mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak, test := test, test_dense := test_dense, test_spec := test_spec } =
      { F := F_1, rot := rot_1, rot_commutes := rot_commutes_1, embed := embed_1, embed_sub := embed_sub_1,
        embed_norm := embed_norm_1, embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero_1, embed_rot := embed_rot_1,
        embed_dilate := embed_dilate_1, mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak_1, test := test_1, test_dense := test_dense_1,
        test_spec := test_spec_1 } →

                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
              ∑ l,
                x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
          ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
              (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p = Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
            ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                  (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                    ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                      (D.mesh.box K).proj
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (fun p' =>
                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                        p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
              (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                  ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                        ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2 else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost * ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                          2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                      else 0) ≤
                    (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                    ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                          ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2 else 0) +
                        if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
                            2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                        else 0) ≤
                      (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                            ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                          ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                        ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                          ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                            ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                              ∃ g, ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧ ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤ (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                  ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    p.1 *
                                      ∑ l,
                                        ∑ c,
                                          ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                  ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                            2 ≤
                                (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                    (fun p =>
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                    (fun p =>
                                      p.1 *
                                        ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p
                                              c‖ ^
                                          2)
                                    (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                    ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K → R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                          0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                            0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                              0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K, 0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                            (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                        if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then 0
                                                        else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                      ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups (P.potential K)
                                                              ι).card /
                                                        (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                  if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then 1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                  else 0) ≤
                                              1) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                  2 * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                    (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                        ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                          2 +
                                                      2 *
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K)
                                                            ι *
                                                        (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
                                                    if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
                                                      (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                                                        (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) *
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^
                                                          2
                                                    else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι) →
                                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                                  2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                              (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
                                                    2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
