                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι) →
                                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                    ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                      (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                          ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K α p a) ≤

                                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                      ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                        (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                            ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K α p a) ≤
                                                          (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,

  (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue D.input x ≤
        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x + Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i => |x i|) →
    D.input.transpose = D.input →
      D.base.transpose = D.base →
        (∀ (j : A ⊕ B), 0 < D.weight j) →
          (∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ E i j) →
            E.transpose = E →
              (∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                F.transpose = F →

                      D.weight i *
                          ∑ j,
                            (|Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.slackRemainder D.input D.base (T.pivots ν) D.pivotValue
                                      D.posColumns (T.nodeColumns ν) i j| +

                        D.radius i) →

                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue

                              x +
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i => |x i|) →

            (∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ E i j) →

                                        D.posColumns D.negColumns i j‖ +
                                    E i j +
                                  F i j) /
                                D.weight j ≤
                          D.radius i) →
                      (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                              (D.factor • Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix D.input) x ≤

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {Q : Fin D.mesh.count → Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingData k}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
              ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                S K x →
                  ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec
                          (fun a b =>
                            1 / 2 *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                          0) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                    S K x →
                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p = 0) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                  ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                    (∃ g a b,
                        ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect] 0) →
                      ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                        0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                          (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                            ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                              (∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    (D.mesh.box K).tailNormSq ((R.layouts K).layout ι).degCoef fun p =>
                                      ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                    ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                      ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                        (∃ g a b,
                            ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                0) →
                          ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                            ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes ∧
                              0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧
                                  ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                        p.1 *
                                          ∑ a,
                                            ∑ b,
                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a
                                                    b‖ ^
                                                2 ≤
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                    ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                      0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                        ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                          0 ≤ Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι) →

                      ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
                        (E.entry j).IsValidOn (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.azimuthOrder (E.modes j)
                          (E.region j)) →
                  (covers :
                      ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                        ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),

                    (floor_bound :
                        ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                          ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
                            ∀ p ∈ E.region j,
                              -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).hess ∧
                                -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curlGrad ∧
                                  -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curl ∧
                                    -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).grad ∧
                                      -E.floor ≤
                                        (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) *
                                          ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).vel) →
                      (resolved_valid :
                          ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                  (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ≤
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                          (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).hess ∧
                                    (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ≤
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                            (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧
                                      (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ≤
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                              (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curl ∧
                                        (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ≤
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                                (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).strain ∧
                                          (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity ≤
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                                (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →
                        (resolved_floor :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                  -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ∧
                                    -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ∧
                                      -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ∧
                                        -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ∧
                                          -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity) →
                          motive ⋯) →
                motive t

                                      (gauge_valid :

                                            L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo) →
                                        (segment_on_side :
                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                              (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧
                                                      (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                                                ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                                    K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                                          (segment_other_in_box :
                                              ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                                  (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                                            (corner_is_corner :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                  ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧
                                                      (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                                              (corner_other :
                                                  ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                    (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                                      (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                                (segEnd_spec :
                                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                      L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                                        L.corner c =

                                                            ((L.segment s).level,
                                                              if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)

                                                            (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi,
                                                              (L.segment s).level)) →

                                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),

                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →

                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                          (L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (height_test_affine :
                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                            ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                                (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                                        (degSide_pos : 1 ≤ L.degSide) →
                                                          (degSide_le : L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef) →
                                                            (cellCorner_spec :
                                                                ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                                  L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                                    L.corner c =
                                                                      (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂,
                                                                        if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                                              (cellCorner_axis :
                                                                  ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                    L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                                (sideSegments_spec :
                                                                    ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                      ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                        ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                                          (L.segment s).level =
                                                                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁

∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {Sp : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.CellSplit k N}
  {M : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshData k N Sp},
  (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsGaugeSpec (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).gaugeSpec) →
    (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (M.coords K).layout.gauge ∧
          (M.coords K).layout.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
            0 ≤ (M.coords K).layout.gauge.lo ∧
              ((M.coords K).layout.gauge.radial = true →
                (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level ≠ 0 ∧
                  0 ≤ min (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level (M.coords K).layout.gauge.other)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
          (M.coords K).gaugeLeft = M.canonicalLeft K ∧ (M.coords K).gaugeRight = M.canonicalRight K) →
        Function.Injective Sp.kappaSlot →
          (∀ (a : Fin k) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
              (j :
                Fin
                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                      (M.coords K).param).card),
              (M.coords K).Tmap j (Sp.kappaSlot a) = 0) →
            Function.Injective M.delaySlot →
              (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (a : Fin k), M.delaySlot j ≠ Sp.kappaSlot a) →
                (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                    (r :
                      Fin
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                            (M.coords K).param).card),
                    (M.coords K).Tmap r (M.delaySlot j) = 0) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots), ∀ p ∈ M.delayExpansion i, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) →
                    (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (l : Fin Sp.slots),
                        ¬M.IsDelaySlot l →
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion (M.delaySlot j)) l =
                            (List.map
                                (fun p =>
                                  p.2 *
                                    if M.IsDelaySlot p.1 then
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion p.1) l
                                    else if p.1 = l then 1 else 0)
                                (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                      (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (i : Fin k),
                          Sp.freeMap (M.delaySlot j) i =
                            (List.map (fun p => p.2 * Sp.freeMap p.1 i) (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount),
                            Sp.delayForm j = Matrix.vecMulVec (M.delayVector j) (M.delayVector j)) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                              (j :
                                Fin
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                      (M.coords K).param).card),
                              ∃ parts extra,
                                (∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                    (M.coords K).Tmap j i' = Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries parts i') ∧
                                  (∀ p ∈ parts, ∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ p.1) ∧
                                    (∀ p ∈ parts, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) ∧
                                      (∀ p ∈ parts,
                                          (M.rowDatum (M.ownerCell p.1) (M.ownerRow p.1)).2 = (M.rowDatum K j).2) ∧
                                        (∀ e ∈ extra, (M.coords e.fst).layout.IsGaugeDeleted e.snd.1) ∧
                                          ((extra = [] ∧
                                                ∃ i,
                                                  parts = [(i, 1)] ∧
                                                    M.rowKey K j = M.ownerKey i ∧
                                                      (M.rowKey K j =
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.private_ →
                                                        M.ownerCell i = K ∧ M.ownerRow i ≍ j)) ∨
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SegmentSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                                                  (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                    M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.FluxSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                                                    (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                      M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                  parts = [] ∧ extra = [] ∧ M.DeletedKey K j (M.rowKey K j)) ∧
                                            ∀ u ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                              ∀ v ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                u.1 = v.1 → u.2 = v.2) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots),
                                (∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ i) →
                                  ¬M.IsDelaySlot i →
                                    ∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                      (M.coords (M.ownerCell i)).Tmap (M.ownerRow i) i' = if i' = i then 1 else 0) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount), (M.coords K).layout.order = c.order) →
                                (∀ (K K' : Fin Sp.cellCount), (M.coords K).layout.gauge = (M.coords K').layout.gauge) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                      ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).radial = true →
                                        ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                          0 ≤
                                            min ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level
                                              ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).other) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                        ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                          ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                            0 ≤
                                              min ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level
                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (cr : Fin (M.coords K).layout.cornerCount),
                                          ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ≠ 0 ∧
                                            ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1 ≠ ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ∧
                                              ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).2 ≠
                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).2 ∧
                                                0 ≤
                                                  min ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1
                                                    ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                            (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.segment s)) ∧
                                              ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s)) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                              (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).lo) ∧
                                                ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).lo) →
                                            (∀ (cl : Fin M.classCount),
                                                (M.classPath cl = [] ↔
                                                    M.nodeClass (M.classRoot cl) (M.classRootSide cl) = cl) ∧
                                                  M.classRootDatum cl ∈ (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).gaugeSpec.roots ∧
                                                    (M.classRootSide cl = true →
                                                        (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefRight
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠
                                                            0 ∧
                                                          (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefLeft
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) =
                                                            0) ∧
                                                      (M.classRootSide cl = false →
                                                        (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefLeft
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠
                                                            0 ∧
                                                          (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefRight
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) =
                                                            0)) →
                                              (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                  ∀ r ∈ (M.coords K).gaugeSpec.roots,
                                                    ∃ cl,
                                                      ∃ (_ : M.classRoot cl = K),
                                                        M.classRootDatum cl ≍ r ∧ M.classPath cl = []) →
                                                (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                                    (e :
                                                      Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount ×
                                                        Fin (M.coords K).layout.degSide),
                                                    (M.coords K).gaugeSpec.edge = some e →
                                                      (M.classRoot (M.nodeClass K true) =
                                                            M.classRoot (M.nodeClass K false) ∧
                                                          M.classRootSide (M.nodeClass K true) =
                                                              M.classRootSide (M.nodeClass K false) ∧
                                                            M.classRootDatum (M.nodeClass K true) ≍
                                                              M.classRootDatum (M.nodeClass K false)) ∧
                                                        (M.classPath (M.nodeClass K true) =
                                                            M.classPath (M.nodeClass K false) ++ [(K, true)] ∨
                                                          M.classPath (M.nodeClass K false) =
                                                            M.classPath (M.nodeClass K true) ++ [(K, false)])) →
                                                  (∀ (K K' : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                      (M.coords K).layout.box.r₁ = 0 →
                                                        (M.coords K').layout.box.r₁ = 0 →
                                                          M.nodeClass K false = M.nodeClass K' false) →
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsMeshData α c Sp M

                                                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                  ‖d.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤

                                                          (defect_rows :

                                                            (defect_le :

                                                              (size :

                                                                    d.coerciveL2 * d.defectBound q +
                                                                          d.defectRowBound q +
                                                                        d.coercivePin *
                                                                          Breakdown.vecNorm (d.targetGap q) ≤
                                                                      (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.sizeBound) →
                                                                (small_first :

                                                                          Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                        d.supBound <

                                                                  (small_second :

                                                                                  d.formBound +
                                                                              2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *

                                                                            2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) /

                                                                                        Breakdown.supBoundFactor

                                                                                    (d.actuatorBound /

                                                                        (adjoint_l2 :

                                                                                      (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →

                                                                                                          (d.actuatorAdjointError

                                                                                              ∑ i, x i ^ 2) →
                                                                                      (stiff_offset :
                                                                                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                            √(∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,

                                                                                                            i -

                                                                                                    2) ≤

    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X] →
      [inst_2 : CompleteSpace X] →
        {motive : Breakdown.Realization X → Sort u} →
          ((F : Breakdown.MildFramework X) →
              (rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X) →
                (rot_commutes : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R)) →
                  (embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X) →
                    (embed_sub :
                        ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                          Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g) →
                      (embed_norm :
                          ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                              ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 =
                                ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2) →
                        (embed_ne_zero :
                            ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                              Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0) →
                          (embed_rot :
                              ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)) →
                            (embed_dilate :
                                ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                  0 < μ →
                                    Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)) →
                              (mild_of_weak :
                                  ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                                    a < b →
                                      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                        ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                          (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                              ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                                  MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                            (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                                  (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                              (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                  Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                      HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                        (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                          Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                        t) →
                                                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                      ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                        (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                                  F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b) →
                                (test : Submodule ℝ X) →
                                  (test_dense : Dense ↑test) →

            ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤
                c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2 →
              0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                  0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                    0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                      0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                        0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                          0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss →
                c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +
                      c.actuatorGradLoss / (2 * c.multiplierScale * √c.weightMin) ≤
                    c.potLoss →
                  √c.rowMax * c.centreLoss + c.rateLoss + (c.velocityLoss + c.curlLoss) / √c.weightMin +
                        c.actuatorLoss / c.multiplierScale ≤
                      c.rowLoss →
                    c.pinFieldLoss / √c.weightMin ≤ c.pinLoss →
                      (∀ (a b : Fin N), c.blockIndex a = c.blockIndex b → c.rowWeight a = c.rowWeight b) →
                        0 ≤ c.baseCoef →
                          (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 ≤ c.levelCoef i) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 < c.levelRate i) →
                              c.splitVisc ^ (1 / (α - 1)) ≤ c.cutoff →

                                      c.levelSum c.cutoff →

                                            (c.baseCoef +
                                                ∑ i, c.levelCoef i * c.spectralBound (c.blockIndex a) (c.levelRate i) +

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData},
  S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
    S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
      (∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
        (∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
          (∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
            (∀ (n : ℤ),
                S.curlAbsorb n =
                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
              (∀ (n : ℤ),
                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                    else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                (∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                  (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                      S.symWeight n j l =
                        S.energyWeight n *
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                K.angularWeight n *
                                  max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^ 2) -
                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                          S.tailShift n) →
                    (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                        S.antiWeight n j l =
                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                      max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^ 2) -
                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                            S.tailShift n) →
                      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                          S.velWeight n j l =
                            (S.tailShift n *
                                if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                              S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  L.order = c.order →
    L.box = K →
      L.bases = B →
        L.modes = S.resolved →
          L.degCoef = S.degHigh →
            L.degSide = S.degLow →
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B →
                  (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                    (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧ L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo →
                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                            (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                              ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                          (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                              ((L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                            (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                  ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧ (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                              (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                  (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                    (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                    L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                      L.corner c =
                                        if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                          ((L.segment s).level, if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                        else
                                          (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi, (L.segment s).level)) →
                                  (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                      L.segEnd s e = none →
                                        ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                    (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                        (L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                        1 ≤ L.degSide →
                                          L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef →
                                            (∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                  L.corner c =
                                                    (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂, if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                              (∀ (i j : Fin 2), L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                    ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                      ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                        (L.segment s).level =
                                                          if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                          else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                  (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                      (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                        ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                          (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                            else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                            ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                              (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                    (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                        ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                          ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                            s ≠ s' →
                                                              (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                (L.segment s').hi ≤ (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount), ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),

  (embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X)
  (embed_sub :
    ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g)
  (embed_norm :
    ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
        ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2)
  (embed_ne_zero : ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0)
  (embed_rot :
    ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f))
  (embed_dilate :
    ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      0 < μ → Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f))
  (mild_of_weak :
    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
      a < b →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2) (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b))
                    (nhds 0)) →
                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ - Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ) t) →
                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ → ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                    F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b)
  (test : Submodule ℝ X) (test_dense : Dense ↑test) (test_spec : ∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x)
  (F_1 : Breakdown.MildFramework X) (rot_1 : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X)
  (rot_commutes_1 : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F_1.Commutes (rot_1 R))

      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
        ‖embed_1 f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2)

      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot_1 R) (embed_1 f) = embed_1 (Breakdown.pushForward R f))
  (embed_dilate_1 :
    ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
      0 < μ → Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F_1.D μ) (embed_1 f) = embed_1 (Breakdown.dilateField μ f))
  (mild_of_weak_1 :
    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
      a < b →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed_1 (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2) (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b))
                    (nhds 0)) →
                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ - Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ) t) →
                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ → ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                    F_1.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed_1 (v t)) a b)
  (test_1 : Submodule ℝ X) (test_dense_1 : Dense ↑test_1)
  (test_spec_1 : ∀ x ∈ test_1, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed_1 φ = x),
  ({ F := F, rot := rot, rot_commutes := rot_commutes, embed := embed, embed_sub := embed_sub, embed_norm := embed_norm,
        embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero, embed_rot := embed_rot, embed_dilate := embed_dilate,
        mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak, test := test, test_dense := test_dense, test_spec := test_spec } =
      { F := F_1, rot := rot_1, rot_commutes := rot_commutes_1, embed := embed_1, embed_sub := embed_sub_1,
        embed_norm := embed_norm_1, embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero_1, embed_rot := embed_rot_1,
        embed_dilate := embed_dilate_1, mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak_1, test := test_1, test_dense := test_dense_1,
        test_spec := test_spec_1 }) =

                                (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level ≠ 0 ∧

                    (gauge_canonical :
                        ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                          (M.coords K).gaugeLeft = M.canonicalLeft K ∧ (M.coords K).gaugeRight = M.canonicalRight K) →
                      (kappa_injective : Function.Injective Sp.kappaSlot) →

                                Fin
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                      (M.coords K).param).card),

                            (delay_not_kappa : ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (a : Fin k), M.delaySlot j ≠ Sp.kappaSlot a) →
                              (delay_unowned :
                                  ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                    (r :
                                      Fin
                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                            (M.coords K).param).card),
                                    (M.coords K).Tmap r (M.delaySlot j) = 0) →
                                (expansion_base : ∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots), ∀ p ∈ M.delayExpansion i, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) →
                                  (expansion_consistent :
                                      ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (l : Fin Sp.slots),
                                        ¬M.IsDelaySlot l →
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries
                                              (M.delayExpansion (M.delaySlot j)) l =

                                                    if M.IsDelaySlot p.1 then
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries
                                                        (M.delayExpansion p.1) l

                                                (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                                    (delay_free :
                                        ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (i : Fin k),
                                          Sp.freeMap (M.delaySlot j) i =
                                            (List.map (fun p => p.2 * Sp.freeMap p.1 i) (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                                      (delay_form :
                                          ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount),
                                            Sp.delayForm j = Matrix.vecMulVec (M.delayVector j) (M.delayVector j)) →
                                        (rows :
                                            ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                              (j :
                                                Fin
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords
                                                      (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).param).card),
                                              ∃ parts extra,
                                                (∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),

                                                      (∀ p ∈ parts,

                                                            (M.rowDatum K j).2) ∧
                                                        (∀ e ∈ extra, (M.coords e.fst).layout.IsGaugeDeleted e.snd.1) ∧

                                                                    (M.rowKey K j)
                                                                    (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                                      M.extraKeys extra) ∨

                                                            ∀ u ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                              ∀ v ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                                u.1 = v.1 → u.2 = v.2) →
                                          (owner_row :
                                              ∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots),

                                                  ¬M.IsDelaySlot i →
                                                    ∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),

                                                        if i' = i then 1 else 0) →
                                            (same_order :
                                                ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount), (M.coords K).layout.order = c.order) →
                                              (same_gauge :
                                                  ∀ (K K' : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                    (M.coords K).layout.gauge = (M.coords K').layout.gauge) →
                                                (radial_segments :
                                                    ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                      ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).radial = true →
                                                        ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                                          0 ≤

                                                              ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).other) →
                                                  (radial_pressure_segments :
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                        ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                                          ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                                            0 ≤
                                                              min ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level
                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →
                                                    (corners_valid :
                                                        ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                                          (cr : Fin (M.coords K).layout.cornerCount),
                                                          ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ≠ 0 ∧

                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ∧

                                                                0 ≤

                                                                    ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1) →
                                                      (segments_valid :

                                                            (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.segment s)) ∧
                                                              ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s)) →
                                                        (segments_nonneg :
                                                            ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                              (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).lo) ∧
                                                                ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).lo) →
                                                          (root_cells :
                                                              ∀ (cl : Fin M.classCount),
                                                                (M.classPath cl = [] ↔
                                                                    M.nodeClass (M.classRoot cl) (M.classRootSide cl) =
                                                                      cl) ∧
                                                                  M.classRootDatum cl ∈
                                                                      (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).gaugeSpec.roots ∧
                                                                    (M.classRootSide cl = true →
                                                                        (M.coords
                                                                                    (M.classRoot
                                                                                      cl)).layout.shiftCoefRight
                                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠
                                                                            0 ∧
                                                                          (M.coords
                                                                                    (M.classRoot
                                                                                      cl)).layout.shiftCoefLeft
                                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) =

                                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠
                                                                            0 ∧
                                                                          (M.coords
                                                                                    (M.classRoot
                                                                                      cl)).layout.shiftCoefRight
                                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) =
                                                                            0)) →
                                                            (roots_exact :

                                                                        Fin (M.coords K).layout.degSide),

                                                              d.supBound ^ 2 →

                                                                      (1 / d.weight +
                                                                        2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.formBound) *
                                                                    d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                  4 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.sizeBound *
                                                                    (d.defectMax +
                                                                        2 * Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                            d.sizeBound *
                                                                          d.supBound +
                                                                      2 * (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) *
                                                                        d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                d.supBound ^ 2 →
                                                              IsUnit d.frame →
                                                                (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                    ∀ q ∈ d.params,

                                                                        ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            ENNReal.ofReal (‖d.adjoint j q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                          ENNReal.ofReal (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →
                                                                  (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointL2 j) →
                                                                    (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                                      (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem.casesOn
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d → Sort u} →
        (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d) →
          ((order_ge : 3 ≤ d.order) →
              (coercivity_pos : 0 < d.coercivity) →
                (coercivity_lt : d.coercivity < d.splitVisc) →
                  (pinWeight_pos : 0 < d.pinWeight) →
                    (rowMax_pos : 0 < d.rowMax) →
                      (multiplierScale_pos : 0 < d.multiplierScale) →
                        (radius_nonneg : ∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                          (slope_ne_zero : ∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                            (ellipsoidRadius_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                              (ellipsoid_le : ∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                (frame_near :
                                    ∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ),
                                      |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                                  (frameDefect_lt : d.frameDefect < 1) →
                                    (pinGap_bound :
                                        ∑ l,
                                            ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                                          d.pinGap ^ 2) →
                                      (pinGap_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.pinGap) →
                                        (losses_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss) →
                                          (reduced_pos : 0 < d.reducedCoercivity) →
                                            (reduced_le : d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss) →
                                              (lowLoss_bound :
                                                  ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                    0 < κ₀ →
                                                      max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤
                                                        d.lowLoss * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2)) →
                                                (reducedGap_pos : 0 < d.reducedGap) →
                                                  (formScale_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formScale) →
                                                    (formScale_bound :
                                                        ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                          0 < κ₀ →
                                                            1 ≤
                                                              d.formScale ^ 2 *
                                                                (κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1)) - d.splitVisc +
                                                                  d.reducedCoercivity * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2))) →
                                                      (splitBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.splitBound) →
                                                        (contraction_lt : d.contraction < 1) →
                                                          (productConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.productConst) →
                                                            (defect_norm :
                                                                ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.projectedNorm (d.defect α p) ≤
                                                                    d.defectBound) →
                                                              (defect_rows :
                                                                  ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                    d.rowsModGrad (d.defect α p) ≤ d.defectRowBound) →
                                                                (size_ge :
                                                                    d.boundFn d.defectBound d.defectRowBound 0 ≤
                                                                      d.sizeBound) →
                                                                  (size_small :
                                                                      4 * d.rowConst * d.productConst * d.sizeBound <
                                                                        1) →
                                                                    (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                        ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                          ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                            0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                                      (active_inclusion :
                                                                          ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                            ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                              ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                                d.adjointQuad j p * d.heldRadius ^ 2 +
                                                                                      d.heldRadius *
                                                                                        √((d.adjointLocal j p +
                                                                                                  d.adjointSpread j p +
                                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                      (d.adjointPin j
                                                                                                        p) *
                                                                                                    d.pinGap /
                                                                                                  √d.weightMin) ^
                                                                                              2 +
                                                                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                  (d.adjointError j p) ^
                                                                                                2 /
                                                                                              d.multiplierScale ^ 2) +
                                                                                    |d.adjustedMultiplier α p' j| ≤
                                                                                  |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                        (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                            ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                              √(1 + d.frameDefect) * d.heldRadius /
                                                                                    d.multiplierScale +
                                                                                  √(∑ j ∈ d.activeSetᶜ,
                                                                                      (d.frame.transpose.mulVec
                                                                                            (d.multiplier p') j -
                                                                                          d.slope j * p' j) ^
                                                                                        2) ≤
                                                                                d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                                                                          (nontrivial :
                                                                              ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                                d.heldRadius / √d.weightMin <
                                                                                  √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                        (d.gradProfile p y))) →
                                                                            motive ⋯) →
            motive t
