declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).potentialKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.potentialExact D R K (P.potential K) x -
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highOwnAmount D K (P.potential K) (D.mesh.resolved K)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperProfiles D R K (P.potential K) x)) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
            S K x →
              ∑ ι,
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι true /
                      (P.potential K).strainBalance ↑ι +
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι false /
                      (P.potential K).velBalance ↑ι) ≤
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (P.potential K).portForm x) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, 0 < (P.potential K).strainBalance ι ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).velBalance ι) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                0 < (P.potential K).groupBalance i ∧
                  0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupStrain i ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupGrad i) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).length) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).epsLength) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                      (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(7 / 2) ∨ (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(9 / 2)) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsStrain ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsGrad) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                            (R.leaves K).strainAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).strainBalance ι +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                  (2 * (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                    3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) ≤
                              (A.blocks K).potentialStrainCost ι) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                              (R.leaves K).velocityAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).velBalance ι +
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                    (3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) ≤
                                (A.blocks K).potentialVelCost ι) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (α : ℤ × ℤ),
                              α ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels ↔
                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic D.azimuthOrder α ∈ D.givenLabels) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                    S K x →
                                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 12),
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).potentialSource ι') x p
                                            j =
                                          ∑ ι,
                                            ∑ j',
                                              (P.potential K).couplingModel (ι' - ↑ι) p j j' *
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.lowProfile D R K ι
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperPart D R K (P.potential K) x) p
                                                  j') →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K) (j : Fin 12),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>
                                        (A.blocks K).potentialSource ι d p j) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    (D.modelErrors K).strainHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highStrain ∧
                                      (D.modelErrors K).vorticityGradHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highGrad) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      0 < (P.potential K).youngCurl ∧
                                        0 < (P.potential K).youngStrain ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).youngVel) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                            (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                        (P.potential K).longStrain +
                                                    (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                                  (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ≤
                                                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
                                              ((⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) *
                                                            (P.potential K).epsLength +
                                                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) +
                                                    if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
                                                (⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) /
                                                            (P.potential K).length +
                                                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) +
                                                    (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι ≤
                                                  (R.entryCharges K ι).velCharge p) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), Disjoint (A.blocks K).leakModes (D.mesh.band K)) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                            Disjoint ((P.potential K).groupPartners i) (D.mesh.band K)) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                              Disjoint ((P.potential K).groupPartners i) (D.mesh.resolved K)) →
                                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                  ∀ α ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K,
                                                    ι - α ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                                                      ι - α ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                                        ∃ i,
                                                          ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupModes i ∧
                                                            ι - α ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i ∧
                                                              -α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics i) →
                                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                  ∀ β ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics i,
                                                    -β ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels) →
                                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i j : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                    ∀ β ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics i,
                                                      β ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics j → i = j) →
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsHarmonicExpansion D.givenLabels D.given
                                                      D.givenHess →
                                                    (∃ B,
                                                        Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsWeakSecondDerivState D.given
                                                          D.givenHess B) →
                                                      1 ≤ D.azimuthOrder →
                                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.EntryChargesRegular D R →
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyRegular D R →

                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →

                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.segment s)) ∧

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.mk.noConfusion
declarations.type:
{X : Type u_1} →
  {inst : NormedAddCommGroup X} →
    {inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X} →
      {inst_2 : CompleteSpace X} →
        {P : Sort u} →
          {F : Breakdown.MildFramework X} →
            {rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X} →
              {rot_commutes : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R)} →
                {embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X} →
                  {embed_sub :
                      ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g} →
                    {embed_norm :
                        ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                          Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                            ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 =
                              ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2} →
                      {embed_ne_zero :
                          ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0} →
                        {embed_rot :
                            ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                              Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)} →
                          {embed_dilate :
                              ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                0 < μ →
                                  Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)} →
                            {mild_of_weak :
                                ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                                  a < b →
                                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                      ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                            ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                                MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                          (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                              Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                                (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                            (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                  ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                    HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                      (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                        Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                      t) →
                                              (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                  Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                    ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                      (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                                F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b} →
                              {test : Submodule ℝ X} →
                                {test_dense : Dense ↑test} →
                                  {test_spec : ∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x} →
                                    {F' : Breakdown.MildFramework X} →
                                      {rot' : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X} →
                                        {rot_commutes' :
                                            ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F'.Commutes (rot' R)} →
                                          {embed' : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X} →
                                            {embed_sub' :
                                                ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                  Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                                    Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed' (f - g) = embed' f - embed' g} →
                                              {embed_norm' :
                                                  ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                                      ‖embed' f‖ ^ 2 =
                                                        ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                          ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2} →
                                                {embed_ne_zero' :
                                                    ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                      Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed' f ≠ 0} →
                                                  {embed_rot' :
                                                      ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                                        (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                        Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                                          (rot' R) (embed' f) = embed' (Breakdown.pushForward R f)} →
                                                    {embed_dilate' :
                                                        ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                          0 < μ →
                                                            Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                                              (F'.D μ) (embed' f) =
                                                                embed' (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)} →
                                                      {mild_of_weak' :
                                                          ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                                                            a < b →
                                                              (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                                                ContinuousOn (fun t => embed' (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                                                  (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                                      ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                          (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                                                          MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                                    (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                                        Filter.Tendsto
                                                                          (fun t =>
                                                                            ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                              ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                                                          (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                                                      (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                                          Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                                            ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                                              HasDerivAt
                                                                                (fun τ =>
                                                                                  Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                                                (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                                                  Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                                                t) →
                                                                        (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                                              ContinuousOn
                                                                                (fun τ =>
                                                                                  Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                                                (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                                                          F'.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed' (v t)) a b} →
                                                        {test' : Submodule ℝ X} →
                                                          {test_dense' : Dense ↑test'} →
                                                            {test_spec' :
                                                                ∀ x ∈ test',
                                                                  ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed' φ = x} →
                                                              { F := F, rot := rot, rot_commutes := rot_commutes,
                                                                    embed := embed, embed_sub := embed_sub,
                                                                    embed_norm := embed_norm,
                                                                    embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero,
                                                                    embed_rot := embed_rot,
                                                                    embed_dilate := embed_dilate,
                                                                    mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak, test := test,
                                                                    test_dense := test_dense, test_spec := test_spec } =
                                                                  { F := F', rot := rot', rot_commutes := rot_commutes',
                                                                    embed := embed', embed_sub := embed_sub',
                                                                    embed_norm := embed_norm',
                                                                    embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero',
                                                                    embed_rot := embed_rot',
                                                                    embed_dilate := embed_dilate',
                                                                    mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak', test := test',
                                                                    test_dense := test_dense',
                                                                    test_spec := test_spec' } →
                                                                (F ≍ F' →
                                                                    rot ≍ rot' → embed ≍ embed' → test ≍ test' → P) →
                                                                  P

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L →
    (∀ n ∈ L.modes, -n ∈ L.modes) →
      (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
          (L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                K.z₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
            ¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
        (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
            ((L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.presSegment s).level) ∧
              (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.presSegment s).level)) →
          (∀ (e : Fin 4),
              (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                ∀ (u : ℝ),
                  (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂ else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                    ∃ s,
                      ((L.presSegment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                        ((L.presSegment s).level =
                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁ else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) ∧
                          (L.presSegment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.presSegment s).hi) →
            (∀ (s s' : Fin L.presCount),
                s ≠ s' →
                  (L.presSegment s).radial = (L.presSegment s').radial →
                    (L.presSegment s).level = (L.presSegment s').level →
                      (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ (L.presSegment s').lo ∨ (L.presSegment s').hi ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo) →
              (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                  d < L.degSide →
                    d' < L.degSide →
                      ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.presSegment s).lo (L.presSegment s).hi,
                          (L.presSegment s).test d u * (L.presSegment s).test d' u =
                        if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.IsPairSurrogate.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {S : Fin k → Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} {ePair : Fin D.mesh.count → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin k), ∀ ι ∈ S i, ι ∈ R.pairLabels ∧ -ι ∈ R.pairLabels) →
    (∀ (i : Fin k) (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ (D.pinValues i).labels K, ι ∈ R.pairLabels ∧ -ι ∈ R.pairLabels) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
              R.pairProfile K (Sum.inr i) ι p a b =
                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.pin i) a b p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin k),
            ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
              ι ∉ R.pairSlackLabels K →
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                    R.pairProfile K (Sum.inl i) ι p a b =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i))
                        a b p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin k ⊕ Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (a b : Fin 3),
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b)
                  (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                ∃ c, ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect, ‖R.pairProfile K g ι p a b‖ ≤ c) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), R.pairSlackLabels K ⊆ R.pairLabels) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                    ∑ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K,
                        (4 * R.pairSlackWeight K ι)⁻¹ *
                          ∑ i,
                            ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                              p.1 *
                                ∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    ‖R.pairProfile K (Sum.inl i) ι p a b -
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι
                                            (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i)) a b p‖ ^
                                      2 ≤
                      ePair K) →
                  Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.IsPairSurrogate D R S ePair

                  ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖T.localMatrix ι p i j‖ ≤ C) →
              (∀ ι ∈ resolved,

                                      (ch.gradient ι p) (ch.length ι p) s v -
                                  T.boxPairPenalty ι s v) +
                              T.absorbValue ι s v) →
                  (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p ∧ 0 < ch.length ι p) →
                    (∀ ι ∈ resolved,

                            T.curlAbsorb (-ι) = T.curlAbsorb ι ∧

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N},
  3 ≤ d.order →
    0 < d.coercivity →
      d.coercivity < d.splitVisc →
        0 < d.pinWeight →
          0 < d.rowMax →
            0 < d.multiplierScale →
              (∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                (∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                  0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius →
                    (∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                      (∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ), |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                        d.frameDefect < 1 →
                          ∑ l, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                              d.pinGap ^ 2 →
                            0 ≤ d.pinGap →
                              0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss →
                                0 < d.reducedCoercivity →
                                  d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss →
                                    (∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                        0 < κ₀ →
                                          max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤
                                            d.lowLoss * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2)) →
                                      0 < d.reducedGap →
                                        0 ≤ d.formScale →
                                          (∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                              0 < κ₀ →
                                                1 ≤
                                                  d.formScale ^ 2 *
                                                    (κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1)) - d.splitVisc +
                                                      d.reducedCoercivity * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2))) →
                                            0 ≤ d.splitBound →
                                              d.contraction < 1 →
                                                0 ≤ d.productConst →
                                                  (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.projectedNorm (d.defect α p) ≤
                                                        d.defectBound) →
                                                    (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                        d.rowsModGrad (d.defect α p) ≤ d.defectRowBound) →
                                                      d.boundFn d.defectBound d.defectRowBound 0 ≤ d.sizeBound →
                                                        4 * d.rowConst * d.productConst * d.sizeBound < 1 →
                                                          (∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                              ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                            (∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                  ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                    d.adjointQuad j p * d.heldRadius ^ 2 +
                                                                          d.heldRadius *
                                                                            √((d.adjointLocal j p +
                                                                                      d.adjointSpread j p +
                                                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                          (d.adjointPin j p) *
                                                                                        d.pinGap /
                                                                                      √d.weightMin) ^
                                                                                  2 +
                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                      (d.adjointError j p) ^
                                                                                    2 /
                                                                                  d.multiplierScale ^ 2) +
                                                                        |d.adjustedMultiplier α p' j| ≤
                                                                      |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                                              (∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                  √(1 + d.frameDefect) * d.heldRadius /
                                                                        d.multiplierScale +
                                                                      √(∑ j ∈ d.activeSetᶜ,
                                                                          (d.frame.transpose.mulVec (d.multiplier p')
                                                                                j -
                                                                              d.slope j * p' j) ^
                                                                            2) ≤
                                                                    d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                                                                (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                    d.heldRadius / √d.weightMin <
                                                                      √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                            (d.gradProfile p y))) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests.rec
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
      {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
        {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
          {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c K S W → Sort u} →
              ((order_ge : 3 ≤ c.order) →
                  (energy_pos : 0 < W.energy) →
                    (energy_le : W.energy ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                      (vorticity_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.vorticity) →
                        (vorticity_le : W.vorticity ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                          (shift_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.shift) →
                            (floor_pos : 0 < S.weightFloor) →
                              (range_pos : 0 ≤ W.rLo) →
                                (range_spec :
                                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        W.rLo ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ∧
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ≤ W.rHi) →
                                  (mean_le :
                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.meanGradBound p ≤
                                          2 * W.meanConst) →
                                    (wave_le :
                                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.waveGradBound p ≤
                                            2 * W.waveConst) →
                                      (lam_le : ∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.strainBound p ≤ W.lamMax) →
                                        (weight_le :
                                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sampleWeight c p ≤
                                                W.weightMax) →
                                          (splitLength_pos : 0 < S.splitLength) →
                                            (consts_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ W.waveConst ∧ 0 ≤ c.coercivity) →
                                              (penalties_nonneg :
                                                  0 ≤ S.penaltyStrain ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyCurl ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyVelocity) →
                                                (curl_band_ge :
                                                    max (W.rLo * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                                        (W.rHi * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                                      W.curlBand) →
                                                  (curl_out_ge :
                                                      max
                                                          (W.rLo *
                                                            (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl -
                                                              (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                                          (W.rHi *
                                                            (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl -
                                                              (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                                        W.curlOut) →
                                                    (strain_base_ge :
                                                        max
                                                            (W.rLo *
                                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax)))
                                                            (W.rHi *
                                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax))) ≤
                                                          W.strainBase) →
                                                      (strain_quad_ge :
                                                          W.rHi * W.waveConst / S.splitLength ≤ W.strainQuad) →
                                                        (sym_resolved_radial :
                                                            S.weightFloor ≤
                                                              W.energy *
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                      K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                                  W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                W.shift) →
                                                          (sym_resolved_height :
                                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                W.energy *
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                        K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                    W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                  W.shift) →
                                                            (anti_resolved_radial :
                                                                S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                  (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                            K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                                        2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                                      W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                    W.shift) →
                                                              (anti_resolved_height :
                                                                  S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                    (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                              K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                          2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                                        W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                      W.shift) →
                                                                (sym_band :
                                                                    S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                      W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order) true) →
                                                                  (sym_out :
                                                                      S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                        W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order)
                                                                          false) →
                                                                    (anti_band :
                                                                        S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                          W.antiAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order)
                                                                            true) →
                                                                      (anti_out :
                                                                          S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                            W.antiAt K S 0 0
                                                                              (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false) →
                                                                        (vel_radial :
                                                                            S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                              W.shift *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen
                                                                                    K S.degHigh -
                                                                                W.resolvedVelocity) →
                                                                          (vel_height :
                                                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                                W.shift *
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen
                                                                                      K S.degHigh -
                                                                                  W.resolvedVelocity) →
                                                                            motive ⋯) →
                (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c K S W) → motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientConditions.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {E : Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientEntry C nE nM},
  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
      ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
        (E.entry j).IsValidOn (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.azimuthOrder (E.modes j) (E.region j)) →
    (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
        ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect → ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K ∧ ι ∉ D.mesh.band K) →
            ∃ j, ι ∈ E.modes j ∧ p ∈ E.region j) →
      (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
          ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
            ∀ p ∈ E.region j,
              -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).hess ∧
                -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curlGrad ∧
                  -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curl ∧
                    -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).grad ∧
                      -E.floor ≤
                        (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).vel) →
        (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ≤
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                          D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).hess ∧
                    (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ≤
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                            D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧
                      (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ≤
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                              D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curl ∧
                        (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ≤
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                                D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).strain ∧
                          (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity ≤
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                                D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ∧
                    -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ∧
                      -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ∧
                        -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ∧
                          -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity) →
            Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientConditions D E

  {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}

  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => v z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => G z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => H z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => g z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic v →
            Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic G →
              Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic H →
                Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic g →
                  (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (v σ) (G σ)) →
                    (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ),
                        ∀ (j : Fin 3),
                          Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                            (H σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                      (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ((G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)).ofLp i = 0) →
                        (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖v σ y‖ ^ 6) < ⊤) →
                          (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => Breakdown.matSq (G σ y)) < ⊤ →

                                (∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                    Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestVector φ →
                                      ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                          inner ℝ (v z.1 z.2)
                                            (-(1 / P) • deriv (fun s => φ s z.2) z.1 - φ z.1 z.2 -
                                              (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) z.2) =
                                        ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (g z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2)) →
                                  (∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), v (z.1 + γ.2) (γ.1 z.2) = γ.1 (v z.1 z.2)) →

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ProfileShapeEntry k}
  {Pr : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.PressureShapeEntry k}
  {Z : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.AdjointShapeEntry k}
  {O : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry k},
  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, 1 / D.cert.period q = O.freqCentre + ∑ i, q i * O.freqTangent i) →
    (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, ∀ (l : Fin k), D.cert.multiplier q l = O.multCentre l + ∑ i, q i * O.multTangent i l) →
      (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
          |O.offsetCentre j -
                (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multCentre l -
                  Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                    (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.centreCoefficient D R Pr O)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
            O.centreErr j) →
        (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
            ∀ (i : Fin k),
              |O.offsetLinear j i -
                    (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multTangent i l -
                      Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                        (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.linearCoefficient D R Pr O i)
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
                O.linearErr j i) →
          (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
              ∀ (i l : Fin k),
                i ≤ l →
                  |O.offsetQuad j i l +
                        Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                          (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.quadraticCoefficient R O i l)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j))| ≤
                    O.quadErr j i l) →
            0 ≤ O.farDefect →
              (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet, 0 ≤ O.farAdjoint j) →
                (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                        if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then ‖D.cert.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
                      ENNReal.ofReal (O.farDefect ^ 2)) →
                  (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                      (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                          if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then
                            ‖Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j) σ y‖ ^ 2
                          else 0) ≤
                        ENNReal.ofReal (O.farAdjoint j ^ 2)) →
                    (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                        D.cert.adjointOffset j = Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.offsetSum D.cert O j) →
                      Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.IsOffsetExpansionEntry D R Pr Z O

declarations.type:

  {k N : ℕ} →
    {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d → Sort u} →
        ((order_ge : 3 ≤ d.order) →
            (coercivity_pos : 0 < d.coercivity) →
              (coercivity_lt : d.coercivity < d.splitVisc) →
                (pinWeight_pos : 0 < d.pinWeight) →
                  (rowMax_pos : 0 < d.rowMax) →
                    (multiplierScale_pos : 0 < d.multiplierScale) →
                      (radius_nonneg : ∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                        (slope_ne_zero : ∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                          (ellipsoidRadius_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                            (ellipsoid_le : ∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                              (frame_near :
                                  ∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                                (frameDefect_lt : d.frameDefect < 1) →
                                  (pinGap_bound :
                                      ∑ l,
                                          ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                                        d.pinGap ^ 2) →
                                    (pinGap_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.pinGap) →
                                      (losses_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss) →
                                        (reduced_pos : 0 < d.reducedCoercivity) →
                                          (reduced_le : d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss) →
                                            (lowLoss_bound :
                                                ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                  0 < κ₀ →
                                                    max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤

∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}

  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},

    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
      S K x →
        (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
          (∑ ι,
                if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                  ∑ d,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                        (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d

                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))

                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
            ∑ l,
              x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)

                    (test_slope_bound : ∀ (i : Fin R.testCount), LipschitzWith R.testSlope (R.test i)) →
                      (test_sides :
                          ∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (z : ℝ), R.test i (R.inner, z) = 0 ∧ R.test i (R.outer, z) = 0) →
                        (test_top : ∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (r : ℝ), R.test i (r, R.height) = 0) →
                          (segments :
                              ∀ (s : Fin R.segmentCount), Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsPlaneSegment (R.segment s)) →
                            (segments_cover :
                                ∀ (r : ℝ),
                                  R.inner ≤ r → r ≤ R.outer → ∃ s, (R.segment s).lower ≤ r ∧ r ≤ (R.segment s).upper) →

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {E : Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientEntry C nE nM},
  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,

        (E.entry j).IsValidOn (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.azimuthOrder (E.modes j) (E.region j)) →
    (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
        ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect → ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K ∧ ι ∉ D.mesh.band K) →
            ∃ j, ι ∈ E.modes j ∧ p ∈ E.region j) →
      (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
          ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
            ∀ p ∈ E.region j,
              -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).hess ∧
                -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curlGrad ∧
                  -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curl ∧
                    -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).grad ∧
                      -E.floor ≤
                        (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).vel) →
        (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ≤
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                          D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).hess ∧
                    (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ≤
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                            D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧
                      (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ≤
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                              D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curl ∧
                        (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ≤
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                                D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).strain ∧
                          (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity ≤
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                                D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ∧
                    -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ∧
                      -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ∧
                        -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ∧

                ((layout : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) →
                    (modes_symm : ∀ n ∈ L.modes, -n ∈ L.modes) →
                      (presSegment_on_side :
                          ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                            (L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.presSegment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧
                                    (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                              ¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.presSegment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                        (presSegment_other_in_box :
                            ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                              ((L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.presSegment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.presSegment s).level) ∧
                                (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.presSegment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.presSegment s).level)) →
                          (presSides_cover :
                              ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                  ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                    (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂ else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                      ∃ s,
                                        ((L.presSegment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                          ((L.presSegment s).level =
                                              if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                              else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) ∧
                                            (L.presSegment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.presSegment s).hi) →
                            (presSides_disjoint :
                                ∀ (s s' : Fin L.presCount),
                                  s ≠ s' →
                                    (L.presSegment s).radial = (L.presSegment s').radial →
                                      (L.presSegment s).level = (L.presSegment s').level →

                              (presSegment_orthonormal :
                                  ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                    d < L.degSide →

                                        ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.presSegment s).lo (L.presSegment s).hi,
                                            (L.presSegment s).test d u * (L.presSegment s).test d' u =
                                          if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsReducedLosses.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {D : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.ProfileData k}
  {A : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.AuxData k} {M : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.CellMesh}
  {RD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData M N} {X : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellSystemData k N M},
  (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖c.strainError y‖ ≤ X.strainOpBound) →
    X.strainOpBound ≤ c.strainLoss →
      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order (fun y => ‖c.curlGradError y‖ ^ 2) X.curlGradSums →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curlGradSums →
          (∀ (a : Fin X.curlGradSums.boxCount), X.curlGradSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curlGradKernel) →
            √X.curlGradKernel ≤ c.curlGradLoss →
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order (fun y => c.cellWeight y * ‖c.curlError y‖ ^ 2)
                  X.curlSums →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curlSums →
                  (∀ (a : Fin X.curlSums.boxCount), X.curlSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curlKernel) →
                    √X.curlKernel ≤ c.curlLoss →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsRowTurnNumbers c M RD X.rateRowConst →
                        (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                            |c.rotationRate p - c.modelRate| * (↑c.order / (↑c.order - 1)) * X.rateRowConst ≤
                              c.rateLoss * √c.weightMin) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k) (β : ℝ),
                              |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.ampField D X.splitStep i β y‖ ≤ X.ampSup i) →
                            (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                  ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                    |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                      ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.fieldOf D.chart (D.part μ) β y‖ ≤
                                          X.higherSup μ) →
                              (∀ (β : ℝ),
                                  |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.phaseCurvField D.chart (D.part 0) β y‖ ≤
                                        X.curvSup) →
                                (∀ (p : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    X.centreSup p =
                                      ∑ i, c.radius i * X.ampSup i +
                                          ∑ μ ∈ D.index with 2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i, (∏ i, c.radius i ^ μ i) * X.higherSup μ +
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius X.splitStep ^ 2 / 2 *
                                          X.curvSup) →
                                  (∀ (i : Fin k), X.splitStep i = -(2 * D.power * ↑D.chart.m * D.rateSlope i)) →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius X.splitStep ≤ X.splitRange →
                                      (∀ (i : Fin k), Pi.single i 1 ∈ D.index) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin k) (β : ℝ),
                                            |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.ampField D X.splitStep i β))
                                                (X.ampSums i)) →
                                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order (X.ampSums i)) →
                                            (∀ (i : Fin k) (a : Fin (X.ampSums i).boxCount),
                                                (X.ampSums i).boxBound a ≤ X.ampKernel i ^ 2) →
                                              (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                  2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                    ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                      |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.fieldOf D.chart (D.part μ)
                                                              β))
                                                          (X.higherSums μ)) →
                                                (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                    2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order
                                                        (X.higherSums μ)) →
                                                  (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                      2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                        ∀ (a : Fin (X.higherSums μ).boxCount),
                                                          (X.higherSums μ).boxBound a ≤ X.higherKernel μ ^ 2) →
                                                    (∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                        |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.phaseCurvField D.chart
                                                                (D.part 0) β))
                                                            X.curvSums) →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curvSums →
                                                        (∀ (a : Fin X.curvSums.boxCount),
                                                            X.curvSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curvKernel ^ 2) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin k), 0 ≤ X.ampKernel i) ∧
                                                              (∀ (μ : Fin k → ℕ), 0 ≤ X.higherKernel μ) ∧
                                                                0 ≤ X.curvKernel →
                                                            ∑ i, c.radius i * X.ampKernel i +
                                                                    ∑ μ ∈ D.index with 2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i,
                                                                      (∏ i, c.radius i ^ μ i) * X.higherKernel μ +
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius
                                                                          X.splitStep ^
                                                                        2 /
                                                                      2 *
                                                                    X.curvKernel ≤
                                                                X.centreKernel →
                                                              0 ≤ X.centreKernel →
                                                                (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                                                                    X.centreSup p + X.centreKernel ≤
                                                                      c.centreLoss * √c.weightMin) →
                                                                  (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-1 / 2) * (27 / 256) ^ (1 / 4) *
                                                                        c.weightMin ^ (-3 / 4) ≤
                                                                      c.productConst →
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius
                                                                          A.phaseSlope ≤
                                                                        X.splitRange →
                                                                      (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                          ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                            ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                                              |β - A.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded
                                                                                  c.order (fun y => ⋯ / X.weightValue)
                                                                                  (X.adjointSums j γ)) →
                                                                        (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                            ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues
                                                                                c.order (X.adjointSums j γ)) →
                                                                          (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                              ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                                ∀
                                                                                  (a :
                                                                                    Fin (X.adjointSums j γ).boxCount),
                                                                                  (X.adjointSums j γ).boxBound a ≤
                                                                                    X.adjointPartKernel j γ ^ 2) →
                                                                            (∀ (j : Fin k) (γ : Fin k → ℕ),
                                                                                0 ≤ X.adjointPartKernel j γ) →
                                                                              (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                                  ∑ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.multiPow
                                                                                          γ c.radius *
                                                                                        X.adjointPartKernel j γ ≤
                                                                                    √(X.adjointKernel j)) →
                                                                                (∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ X.adjointKernel j) →
                                                                                  (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                                      ∀
                                                                                        p ∈
                                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.box
                                                                                            c.radius,
                                                                                        √(X.adjointKernel j) /
                                                                                            √c.weightMin ≤
                                                                                          c.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                                                    (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet, ⋯) →
                                                                                      (∀ (j : Fin k), ⋯) →
                                                                                        ⋯ →
                                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsReducedLosses
                                                                                            c D A M RD X

                        (shift_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →

                                S.curlAbsorb n =

                                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain

                                                              min ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level
                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →

                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).2 ∧
                                                                0 ≤
                                                                  min ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1
                                                                    ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1) →
                                                      (segments_valid :
                                                          ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                            (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment

                                                              ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),

                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s)) →

                                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).lo) ∧
                                                                ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
