declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] {T : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.SignedTree A B} {ν : T.Node}
  {D : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ComplexNodeData A B} {E F : Matrix D.Index D.Index ℝ},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.IsCoordinateOn D.coords D.pivot →
    0 ≤ D.factor →
      D.input.conjTranspose = D.input →
        D.base.conjTranspose = D.base →
          (∀ (j : D.Index), 0 < D.weight j) →
            (∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ E i j) →
              E.transpose = E →
                (∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                  F.transpose = F →
                    (∀ (i : D.Index),
                        D.weight i *
                            ∑ j,
                              (‖Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexSlackRemainder D.input D.base D.pivot D.pivotValue
                                        D.posColumns D.negColumns i j‖ +
                                    E i j +
                                  F i j) /
                                D.weight j ≤
                          D.radius i) →
                      (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                              (D.factor • Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix D.input) x ≤
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x +
                              D.factor *
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i =>
                                  ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                        (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                              Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                  (D.factor •
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix
                                      (D.base -
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexDiagonal (Finset.univ \ D.pivot)
                                          D.radius))
                                  x +
                                D.factor *
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i =>
                                    ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                          T.pivots ν = D.coords.pivotImage D.pivot →
                            (∀ k ∈ T.pivots ν,
                                T.slack ν k ≤
                                  D.factor * D.coords.slackOn D.pivot (fun j => D.pivotValue j - D.radius j) k) →
                              (∃ e,
                                  Function.Injective e ∧
                                    ∀ (c : D.Neg ⊕ D.Neg),
                                      T.columnNode (e c) = ν ∧
                                        T.column (e c) =
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realColumns D.coords.matrix D.factor
                                            D.negColumns c) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure T ν D E F

declarations.type:
∀ {count : ℕ} {box : Fin count → Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} {m : ℕ} {K : Fin count} {deg : ℕ}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {model : Breakdown.CertCell.ModelPolys count} {err : Breakdown.CertCell.ModelErrors}
  {high : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelHigh} {long : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelLong},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K) W
      (model.velocity.field box m) high.velocity long.velocity err.velocityHigh long.errVelocity err.velocity →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
        (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityOf W) (model.vorticity.field box m) high.vorticity long.vorticity
        err.vorticityHigh long.errVorticity err.vorticity →
      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
          (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W) (model.strain.field box m) high.strain long.strain err.strainHigh
          long.errStrain err.strain →
        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPartAE (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) (model.vorticityGrad.field box m) high.vorticityGrad
            long.vorticityGrad err.vorticityGradHigh long.errVorticityGrad err.vorticityGrad →
          (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ),
              |α.1| ≤ 2 * ↑long.cut →
                ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                  (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.velocity p a = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.vorticity p a = 0) ∧
                      (∀ (a b : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.strain p (a, b) = 0) ∧
                        ∀ (a b : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.vorticityGrad p (a, b) = 0) →
            ContinuousOn (fun z => long.velocity z.1 z.2)
                  {z |
                    0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                ContinuousOn (fun z => long.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                    {z |
                      0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.strain z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
              (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (long.strain σ y) = long.strain σ y) →
                0 ≤ long.errVelocity ∧ 0 ≤ long.errVorticity ∧ 0 ≤ long.errStrain ∧ 0 ≤ long.errVorticityGrad →
                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsVecOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.velocity →
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsVecOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.vorticity →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.strain →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.vorticityGrad →
                          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (high.strain σ y) = high.strain σ y) →
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.velocity z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                                    MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.strain z.1 z.2)
                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2)
                                      MeasureTheory.volume →
                              model.velocity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                  model.vorticity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                    model.strain.IsConjugateClosed box ∧ model.vorticityGrad.IsConjugateClosed box →
                                0 ≤ err.velocity ∧
                                    0 ≤ err.vorticity ∧
                                      0 ≤ err.strain ∧
                                        0 ≤ err.vorticityGrad ∧
                                          0 ≤ err.velocityHigh ∧
                                            0 ≤ err.vorticityHigh ∧ 0 ≤ err.strainHigh ∧ 0 ≤ err.vorticityGradHigh →
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsCellModelSplit box m K deg W HW model err high long

                                                            D.pivot D.pivotValue D.posColumns D.negColumns i j‖ +

                                              Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                                  (D.factor •
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix

  {M : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshData k N Sp},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsMeshData α c Sp M →
    ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
      (j : Fin (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).param).card),
      ∃ parts extra,
        (∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots), (M.coords K).Tmap j i' = Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries parts i') ∧
          (∀ p ∈ parts, ∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ p.1) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ parts, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) ∧
              (∀ p ∈ parts, (M.rowDatum (M.ownerCell p.1) (M.ownerRow p.1)).2 = (M.rowDatum K j).2) ∧
                (∀ e ∈ extra, (M.coords e.fst).layout.IsGaugeDeleted e.snd.1) ∧
                  ((extra = [] ∧
                        ∃ i,
                          parts = [(i, 1)] ∧
                            M.rowKey K j = M.ownerKey i ∧
                              (M.rowKey K j = Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.private_ →
                                M.ownerCell i = K ∧ M.ownerRow i ≍ j)) ∨
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SegmentSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                          (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++ M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.FluxSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                            (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++ M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                          parts = [] ∧ extra = [] ∧ M.DeletedKey K j (M.rowKey K j)) ∧

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
        S K x →
          (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
            (∑ ι,
                  if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                    ∑ d,
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                          (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                  else 0) +
                ∑ ι',
                  ∑ d,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
              ∑ l,
                x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
          ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
              (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p = Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
            ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                  (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                    ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                      (D.mesh.box K).proj
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (fun p' =>
                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                        p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
              (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                  ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                        ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2 else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost * ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                          2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                      else 0) ≤
                    (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                    ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                          ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2 else 0) +
                        if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
                            2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                        else 0) ≤
                      (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                            ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                          ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                        ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                          ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                            ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                              ∃ g, ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧ ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤ (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                  ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    p.1 *
                                      ∑ l,
                                        ∑ c,
                                          ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                  ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                            2 ≤
                                (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                    (fun p =>
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                    (fun p =>
                                      p.1 *
                                        ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p
                                              c‖ ^
                                          2)
                                    (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                    ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K → R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                          0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                            0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                              0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K, 0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                            (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                        if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then 0
                                                        else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                      ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups (P.potential K)
                                                              ι).card /
                                                        (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                  if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then 1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                  else 0) ≤
                                              1) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                  2 * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                    (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                        ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                          2 +
                                                      2 *
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K)
                                                            ι *

                                                      ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),

                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K α p a) ≤

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.IsTreeCertificate.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : ℕ} {T : Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.TreeCertificate a b},
  (∀ (c : T.Cell), (T.cellForm c).transpose = T.cellForm c) →
    (∀ (ν : T.Node), (T.front ν).transpose = T.front ν) →
      (∀ (ν μ : T.Node), T.parent ν = some μ → T.rank ν < T.rank μ) →
        T.parent T.root = none →
          (∀ (ν : T.Node), T.parent ν = none → ν = T.root) →
            (∀ (ν μ : T.Node), ν ≠ μ → Disjoint (T.eliminated ν) (T.eliminated μ)) →
              (∀ (ν : T.Node) (x y : Fin a ⊕ Fin b → ℝ),
                  (∀ i ∉ T.eliminated ν, x (Sum.inl i) = y (Sum.inl i)) →
                    (∀ (j : Fin b), x (Sum.inr j) = y (Sum.inr j)) →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x =
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) y) →
                (∀ (ν : T.Node) (x : Fin a ⊕ Fin b → ℝ),
                    Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x) →
                  (∀ (x y : Fin a ⊕ Fin b → ℝ),
                      (∀ (i : Fin a), ¬T.IsEliminatedSomewhere i → x (Sum.inl i) = y (Sum.inl i)) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin b), x (Sum.inr j) = y (Sum.inr j)) →
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front T.root + T.globalForm) x =
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front T.root + T.globalForm) y) →
                    (∃ P ≤ T.rootSpace,
                        Nat.card { i // ¬T.IsEliminatedSomewhere i } ≤ Module.finrank ℝ ↥P ∧
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.IsPositiveOn (T.front T.root + T.globalForm) P) →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.IsTreeCertificate T

declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ProfileShapeEntry k} →
          {Pr : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.PressureShapeEntry k} →
            {Z : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.AdjointShapeEntry k} →
              {O : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry k} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.IsOffsetExpansionEntry D R Pr Z O → Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.IsOffsetExpansionEntry D R Pr Z O) →
                    ((period_eq :
                          ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, 1 / D.cert.period q = O.freqCentre + ∑ i, q i * O.freqTangent i) →
                        (multiplier_eq :
                            ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                              ∀ (l : Fin k), D.cert.multiplier q l = O.multCentre l + ∑ i, q i * O.multTangent i l) →
                          (centre_close :
                              ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                |O.offsetCentre j -
                                      (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multCentre l -
                                        Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                                          (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.centreCoefficient
                                            D R Pr O)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
                                  O.centreErr j) →
                            (linear_close :
                                ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                  ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                    |O.offsetLinear j i -
                                          (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multTangent i l -
                                            Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                                              (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.linearCoefficient
                                                D R Pr O i)
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
                                      O.linearErr j i) →
                              (quad_close :
                                  ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                    ∀ (i l : Fin k),
                                      i ≤ l →
                                        |O.offsetQuad j i l +
                                              Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                                                (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.quadraticCoefficient
                                                  R O i l)
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j))| ≤
                                          O.quadErr j i l) →
                                (farDefect_nonneg : 0 ≤ O.farDefect) →
                                  (farAdjoint_nonneg : ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet, 0 ≤ O.farAdjoint j) →
                                    (far_defect :
                                        ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                          (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                              if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then ‖D.cert.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
                                            ENNReal.ofReal (O.farDefect ^ 2)) →
                                      (far_adjoint :
                                          ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then
                                                  ‖Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j) σ
                                                        y‖ ^
                                                    2
                                                else 0) ≤
                                              ENNReal.ofReal (O.farAdjoint j ^ 2)) →
                                        (offset_eq :
                                            ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                              D.cert.adjointOffset j =
                                                Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.offsetSum D.cert O j) →
                                          motive ⋯) →
                      motive t

  {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsCrossWaveEntry X → Sort u} →

            (vorticityGradBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ X.vorticityGradBound) →

declarations.type:

            (fun a b =>
              Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)

            (Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p))) →
        (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖(Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess σ
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                      u -
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellMatField.frameMap θ fun a b =>
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)

                      (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                  (D.charges none).product ι p =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                    (D.charges none).gradient ι p =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p)) →
            (∀ (ι ι' : ℤ × ℤ),
                ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,

                (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                    0 ≤
                        Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧

declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
          {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L → Sort u} →
              ((layout : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) →
                  (modes_symm : ∀ n ∈ L.modes, -n ∈ L.modes) →
                    (presSegment_on_side :
                        ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                          (L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
                              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                K.z₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧
                                  (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                            ¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
                              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                      (presSegment_other_in_box :
                          ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                            ((L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                (L.presSegment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.presSegment s).level) ∧
                              (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                (L.presSegment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.presSegment s).level)) →
                        (presSides_cover :
                            ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                              (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                  (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂ else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                    ∃ s,
                                      ((L.presSegment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                        ((L.presSegment s).level =
                                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                            else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) ∧
                                          (L.presSegment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.presSegment s).hi) →
                          (presSides_disjoint :
                              ∀ (s s' : Fin L.presCount),
                                s ≠ s' →
                                  (L.presSegment s).radial = (L.presSegment s').radial →
                                    (L.presSegment s).level = (L.presSegment s').level →
                                      (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ (L.presSegment s').lo ∨
                                        (L.presSegment s').hi ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo) →
                            (presSegment_orthonormal :
                                ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                  d < L.degSide →
                                    d' < L.degSide →
                                      ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.presSegment s).lo (L.presSegment s).hi,
                                          (L.presSegment s).test d u * (L.presSegment s).test d' u =
                                        if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                              motive ⋯) →
                (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L) → motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).potentialKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.potentialExact D R K (P.potential K) x -
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highOwnAmount D K (P.potential K) (D.mesh.resolved K)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperProfiles D R K (P.potential K) x)) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
            S K x →
              ∑ ι,
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι true /
                      (P.potential K).strainBalance ↑ι +
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι false /
                      (P.potential K).velBalance ↑ι) ≤
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (P.potential K).portForm x) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, 0 < (P.potential K).strainBalance ι ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).velBalance ι) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                0 < (P.potential K).groupBalance i ∧
                  0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupStrain i ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupGrad i) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).length) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).epsLength) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                      (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(7 / 2) ∨ (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(9 / 2)) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsStrain ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsGrad) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                            (R.leaves K).strainAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).strainBalance ι +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                  (2 * (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                    3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) ≤
                              (A.blocks K).potentialStrainCost ι) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                              (R.leaves K).velocityAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).velBalance ι +
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                    (3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) ≤
                                (A.blocks K).potentialVelCost ι) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (α : ℤ × ℤ),
                              α ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels ↔
                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic D.azimuthOrder α ∈ D.givenLabels) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                    S K x →
                                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 12),
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).potentialSource ι') x p
                                            j =
                                          ∑ ι,
                                            ∑ j',
                                              (P.potential K).couplingModel (ι' - ↑ι) p j j' *
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.lowProfile D R K ι
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperPart D R K (P.potential K) x) p
                                                  j') →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K) (j : Fin 12),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>
                                        (A.blocks K).potentialSource ι d p j) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    (D.modelErrors K).strainHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highStrain ∧
                                      (D.modelErrors K).vorticityGradHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highGrad) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      0 < (P.potential K).youngCurl ∧
                                        0 < (P.potential K).youngStrain ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).youngVel) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                            (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                        (P.potential K).longStrain +
                                                    (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                                  (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ≤
                                                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
                                              ((⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) *
                                                            (P.potential K).epsLength +
                                                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) +
                                                    if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
                                                (⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) /
                                                            (P.potential K).length +
                                                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) +

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.CertificateClauses.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k} →
    {motive : Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.CertificateClauses d → Sort u} →
      (t : Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.CertificateClauses d) →
        ((radius_nonneg : ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
            (stiffRadius_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.stiffRadius) →
              (scale_ne_zero : ∀ (j : Fin k), d.scale j ≠ 0) →
                (weight_le_weightMax : d.weight ≤ d.weightMax) →
                  (multiplierWeight_pos : 0 < d.multiplierWeight) →
                    (coerciveL2_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.coerciveL2) →
                      (coercivePin_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.coercivePin) →
                        (rowBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.rowBound) →
                          (gapSize_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.gapSize) →
                            (formShift_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formShift) →
                              (transfer_lt : d.transferLoss < 1) →
                                (coerciveTotal_ge :
                                    d.coerciveL2 + d.rowBound ≤ (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.coerciveTotal) →
                                  (coerciveTotal_pos : 0 < d.coerciveTotal) →
                                    (actuatorBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.actuatorBound) →
                                      (modelFormBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.modelFormBound) →
                                        (formBound_ge : d.modelFormBound + d.formShift ≤ d.formBound) →
                                          (sizeBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.sizeBound) →
                                            (supBound_pos : 0 < d.supBound) →
                                              (period_le : ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.period q ≤ d.periodMax) →
                                                (twist_pos : 0 < d.twist) →
                                                  (twist_mem :
                                                      d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                                    (actuator_norm :
                                                        (∑ i,
                                                            Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                              ‖d.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                          ENNReal.ofReal (d.actuatorBound ^ 2)) →
                                                      (defect_nonneg :
                                                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                            0 ≤ d.defectBound q ∧ 0 ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                        (defect_l2 :
                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                  ‖d.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                ENNReal.ofReal (d.defectBound q ^ 2)) →
                                                          (defect_rows :
                                                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                d.rows (d.defect q) ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                            (defect_le :
                                                                ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.defectBound q ≤ d.defectMax) →
                                                              (size :
                                                                  ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                    d.coerciveL2 * d.defectBound q +
                                                                          d.defectRowBound q +
                                                                        d.coercivePin *
                                                                          Breakdown.vecNorm (d.targetGap q) ≤
                                                                      (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.sizeBound) →
                                                                (small_first :
                                                                    2 * d.coerciveTotal *
                                                                          Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                        d.supBound <
                                                                      1) →
                                                                  (small_second :
                                                                      4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 *
                                                                          (1 / d.weight +
                                                                                2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                  d.formBound +
                                                                              2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) +
                                                                            2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) /
                                                                              d.coerciveTotal) ≤
                                                                        d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                    (small_third :
                                                                        4 *
                                                                                (1 / d.weight +
                                                                                  2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                    d.formBound) *
                                                                              d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                            4 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.sizeBound *
                                                                              (d.defectMax +
                                                                                  2 *
                                                                                        Breakdown.supBoundFactor
                                                                                          d.weight *
                                                                                      d.sizeBound *
                                                                                    d.supBound +
                                                                                2 *
                                                                                    (d.actuatorBound /
                                                                                      d.multiplierWeight) *
                                                                                  d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                          d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                      (frame_unit : IsUnit d.frame) →
                                                                        (adjoint_l2 :
                                                                            ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                                                                  ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                      ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                        (‖d.adjoint j q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                                    ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                      (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →
                                                                          (adjointL2_nonneg :
                                                                              ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointL2 j) →
                                                                            (adjointDefect_nonneg :
                                                                                ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                  0 ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                                              (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                                  ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                    0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j) →
                                                                                (adjoint_inclusion :
                                                                                    ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                      ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                        d.adjointQuad j *
                                                                                                (2 * d.sizeBound) ^ 2 +
                                                                                              2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                                √(d.adjointDefect j ^
                                                                                                      2 +
                                                                                                    (Breakdown.vecNorm
                                                                                                          (d.actuatorAdjointError
                                                                                                            q j) /
                                                                                                        d.multiplierWeight) ^
                                                                                                      2) +
                                                                                            d.adjointOffset j ≤
                                                                                          |d.scale j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                                  (stiffNorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.stiffNorm) →
                                                                                    (stiff_norm :
                                                                                        ∀ (x : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                                                          ∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                              (∑ i, d.frame i j * x i) ^
                                                                                                2 ≤
                                                                                            d.stiffNorm ^ 2 *
                                                                                              ∑ i, x i ^ 2) →
                                                                                      (stiff_offset :
                                                                                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                            √(∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                                  (∑ i,
                                                                                                        d.frame i j *
                                                                                                          d.multiplier q
                                                                                                            i -
                                                                                                      d.scale j * q j) ^
                                                                                                    2) ≤
                                                                                              d.stiffOffset) →
                                                                                        (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                                            2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                                    d.stiffNorm /
                                                                                                  d.multiplierWeight +
                                                                                                d.stiffOffset ≤
                                                                                              d.stiffRadius) →
                                                                                          (nontrivial :
                                                                                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                                4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 /
                                                                                                    d.weight <
                                                                                                  (Breakdown.periodLIntegral
                                                                                                      ⋯).toReal) →
                                                                                            motive ⋯) →
          motive t

      ((target_continuous : ContinuousOn d.target d.params) →
          (profile_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => d.profile z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) →
            (profile_periodic : ∀ (q : Fin k → ℝ), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profile q)) →
              (profile_divergence :
                  ∀ q ∈ d.params, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (d.profile q σ) y = 0) →
                (profile_decay :
                    ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                        ‖d.profile q σ y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ∧
                          ‖fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ) y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                            ‖d.profileSecondDeriv q σ y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3) →
                  (profileSecondDeriv_measurable :
                      ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.profileSecondDeriv q z.1 z.2)
                          MeasureTheory.volume) →
                    (profileSecondDeriv_periodic : ∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profileSecondDeriv q)) →
                      (profileSecondDeriv_weak :
                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
                              Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j))
                                fun y => (d.profileSecondDeriv q σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                        (profile_invariant :
                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                              ∀ γ ∈ d.symmetries,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  d.profile q (σ + γ.2) (γ.1 y) = γ.1 (d.profile q σ y)) →
                          (pressureGrad_measurable :
                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.pressureGrad q z.1 z.2)
                                  MeasureTheory.volume) →
                            (pressureGrad_periodic : ∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.pressureGrad q)) →
                              (pressureGrad_orthogonal :
                                  ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                    ∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                      Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestField φ →
                                        ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (d.pressureGrad q z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2) =
                                          0) →
                                (adjoint_measurable :
                                    ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                      ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.adjoint j q z.1 z.2)
                                          MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                  (adjoint_periodic :
                                      ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, ∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.adjoint j q)) →
                                    motive ⋯) →
        (t : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.StructuralClauses d) → motive t

  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
          {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L → Sort u} →
              (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L) →
                ((layout : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) →
                    (modes_symm : ∀ n ∈ L.modes, -n ∈ L.modes) →
                      (presSegment_on_side :
                          ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                            (L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.presSegment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧
                                    (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                              ¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.presSegment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                        (presSegment_other_in_box :
                            ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                              ((L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.presSegment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.presSegment s).level) ∧
                                (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.presSegment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.presSegment s).level)) →
                          (presSides_cover :
                              ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                  ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                    (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂ else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                      ∃ s,
                                        ((L.presSegment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                          ((L.presSegment s).level =
                                              if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                              else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) ∧
                                            (L.presSegment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.presSegment s).hi) →
                            (presSides_disjoint :
                                ∀ (s s' : Fin L.presCount),
                                  s ≠ s' →
                                    (L.presSegment s).radial = (L.presSegment s').radial →
                                      (L.presSegment s).level = (L.presSegment s').level →
                                        (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ (L.presSegment s').lo ∨
                                          (L.presSegment s').hi ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo) →
                              (presSegment_orthonormal :
                                  ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                    d < L.degSide →
                                      d' < L.degSide →
                                        ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.presSegment s).lo (L.presSegment s).hi,
                                            (L.presSegment s).test d u * (L.presSegment s).test d' u =
                                          if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

declarations.type:

  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {Q : Fin D.mesh.count → Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingData k}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
              ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                S K x →
                  ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec
                          (fun a b =>
                            1 / 2 *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                          0) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                    S K x →
                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p = 0) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                  ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                    (∃ g a b,
                        ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect] 0) →
                      ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                        0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                          (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                            ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                              (∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    (D.mesh.box K).tailNormSq ((R.layouts K).layout ι).degCoef fun p =>
                                      ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                    ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                      ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                        (∃ g a b,
                            ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                0) →
                          ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                            ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes ∧
                              0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧
                                  ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                        p.1 *
                                          ∑ a,
                                            ∑ b,
                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a
                                                    b‖ ^
                                                2 ≤
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                    ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                      0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                        ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),

  (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
    0 ≤ d.stiffRadius →
      (∀ (j : Fin k), d.scale j ≠ 0) →
        0 < d.weight →
          Measurable d.weightFn →
            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), d.weight ≤ d.weightFn y) →
              (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), d.weightFn y ≤ d.weightMax) →
                (∀ γ ∈ d.symmetries, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), d.weightFn (γ.1 y) = d.weightFn y) →
                  0 < d.multiplierWeight →
                    0 ≤ d.coerciveL2 →
                      0 ≤ d.coercivePin →
                        0 ≤ d.rowBound →
                          0 ≤ d.gapSize →
                            0 ≤ d.formShift →
                              d.transferLoss < 1 →
                                d.coerciveL2 + d.rowBound ≤ (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.coerciveTotal →
                                  0 < d.coerciveTotal →
                                    0 ≤ d.actuatorBound →
                                      0 ≤ d.modelFormBound →
                                        d.modelFormBound + d.formShift ≤ d.formBound →
                                          0 ≤ d.sizeBound →
                                            0 < d.supBound →
                                              ContinuousOn d.period d.params →
                                                (∀ q ∈ d.params, 0 < d.period q) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ d.params, d.period q ≤ d.periodMax) →
                                                    0 < d.twist →
                                                      (d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                                        ContinuousOn d.multiplier d.params →
                                                          ContinuousOn d.target d.params →
                                                            (ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => d.profile z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) →
                                                              (∀ (q : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profile q)) →
                                                                (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                      Breakdown.divergenceAt (d.profile q σ) y = 0) →
                                                                  (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                        ‖d.profile q σ y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ∧
                                                                          ‖fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ) y‖ ≤
                                                                              d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                                                                            ‖d.profileSecondDeriv q σ y‖ ≤
                                                                              d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3) →
                                                                    (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                          (fun z => d.profileSecondDeriv q z.1 z.2)
                                                                          MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                                      (∀ q ∈ d.params,

                      (embed_sub :
                          ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g) →
                        (embed_norm :
                            ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                              Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 =
                                  ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2) →
                          (embed_ne_zero :
                              ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0) →
                            (embed_rot :
                                ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                  Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)) →
                              (embed_dilate :
                                  ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                    0 < μ →
                                      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                        (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)) →
                                (mild_of_weak :
                                    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                                      a < b →
                                        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                                    MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                  Filter.Tendsto
                                                    (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                                    (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                            Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                          t) →
                                                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                        ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                          (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                                    F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b) →
                                  (test : Submodule ℝ X) →
                                    (test_dense : Dense ↑test) →
                                      (test_spec : ∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x) →
                                        motive
                                          { F := F, rot := rot, rot_commutes := rot_commutes, embed := embed,
                                            embed_sub := embed_sub, embed_norm := embed_norm,
                                            embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero, embed_rot := embed_rot,
                                            embed_dilate := embed_dilate, mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak, test := test,
                                            test_dense := test_dense, test_spec := test_spec }) →
              motive t
