declarations.name: Breakdown.IsCertificate.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.CertificateData k},
  (∀ (i : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius i) →
    0 < d.weight →
      Measurable d.weightFn →
        (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), d.weight ≤ d.weightFn y) →
          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), d.weightFn y ≤ d.weightMax) →
            (∀ γ ∈ d.symmetries, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), d.weightFn (γ.1 y) = d.weightFn y) →
              0 ≤ d.coerciveL2 →
                0 ≤ d.coerciveBall →
                  0 ≤ d.coercivePin →
                    d.coerciveL2 + d.coerciveBall ≤ d.coerciveTotal →
                      0 < d.coerciveTotal →
                        0 ≤ d.actuatorBound →
                          0 ≤ d.formBound →
                            0 ≤ d.sizeBound →
                              0 < d.supBound →
                                ContinuousOn d.period d.box →
                                  (∀ p ∈ d.box, 0 < d.period p) →
                                    (∀ p ∈ d.box, d.period p ≤ d.periodMax) →
                                      0 < d.twist →
                                        (d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                          ContinuousOn d.multiplier d.box →
                                            ContinuousOn d.target d.box →
                                              (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun q => d.profile q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) →
                                                (∀ (p : Fin k → ℝ), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profile p)) →
                                                  (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                        Breakdown.divergenceAt (d.profile p σ) y = 0) →
                                                    (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                          ∀ j ≤ 2,
                                                            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (d.profile p σ) y‖ ≤
                                                              d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
                                                      (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                          ∀ γ ∈ d.symmetries,
                                                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                              d.profile p (σ + γ.2) (γ.1 y) = γ.1 (d.profile p σ y)) →
                                                        (∀ p ∈ d.box, ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => d.pressure p z.1 z.2) →
                                                          (∀ p ∈ d.box, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.pressure p)) →
                                                            (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                  (fun z => d.actuator i z.1 z.2)
                                                                  MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                              (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.actuator i)) →
                                                                (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                    ∀ γ ∈ d.symmetries,
                                                                      ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                                        d.actuator i (z.1 + γ.2) (γ.1 z.2) =
                                                                          γ.1 (d.actuator i z.1 z.2)) →
                                                                  (∑ i,
                                                                        Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                          ‖d.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                      ENNReal.ofReal (d.actuatorBound ^ 2) →
                                                                    (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                          (fun z => d.pin i z.1 z.2)
                                                                          MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                                      (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                          (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                              Breakdown.matSq (d.pin i σ y)) <
                                                                            ⊤) →
                                                                        (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                                            ∀
                                                                              (v :
                                                                                ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                              (G :
                                                                                ℝ →
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space)
                                                                              (H :
                                                                                ℝ →
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space)
                                                                              (g :
                                                                                ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                                              Breakdown.IsPerturbation d.symmetries
                                                                                  (d.period p) v G H g →
                                                                                ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ)
                                                                                  (F :
                                                                                    ℝ →
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                                      (fun z => F z.1 z.2)
                                                                                      MeasureTheory.volume →
                                                                                    Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                                                                      ⋯ < ⊤ →
                                                                                        Breakdown.IsRightSide
                                                                                            (d.profile p) d.actuator κ v
                                                                                            G g F →
                                                                                          ⋯) →
                                                                          (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                                              ∀ (σ : ℝ)
                                                                                (w : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                (G :
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                (H :
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                Breakdown.IsProfileField d.symmetries w
                                                                                    G H →
                                                                                  -d.formBound *
                                                                                      Breakdown.stationaryEnergy
                                                                                        d.weightFn G H ≤
                                                                                    Breakdown.frozenForm (d.profile p σ)
                                                                                      w G H) →
                                                                            (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                                                0 ≤ d.defectBound p ∧
                                                                                  0 ≤ d.defectBallBound p) →
                                                                              (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                                                  (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                                      ‖Breakdown.defectField
                                                                                            (d.period p) (d.profile p)
                                                                                            (d.pressure p) d.actuator
                                                                                            (d.multiplier p) σ y‖ ^
                                                                                        2) ≤
                                                                                    ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                      (d.defectBound p ^ 2)) →
                                                                                (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                                                    (Breakdown.periodBallLIntegral
                                                                                        d.ballRadius fun σ y =>
                                                                                        ‖Breakdown.defectField
                                                                                              (d.period p) (d.profile p)
                                                                                              (d.pressure p) d.actuator
                                                                                              (d.multiplier p) σ y‖ ^
                                                                                          2) ≤
                                                                                      ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                        (d.defectBallBound p ^ 2)) →
                                                                                  (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                                                      d.defectBound p ≤ d.defectMax) →
                                                                                    (∀ p ∈ d.box,
                                                                                        (d.coerciveL2 *
                                                                                                d.defectBound p +
                                                                                              d.coerciveBall *
                                                                                                d.defectBallBound p +
                                                                                            d.coercivePin *
                                                                                              Breakdown.vecNorm fun i =>
                                                                                                ⋯) ≤
                                                                                          d.sizeBound) →
                                                                                      2 * d.coerciveTotal *
                                                                                              Breakdown.supBoundFactor
                                                                                                d.weight *
                                                                                            d.supBound <
                                                                                          1 →
                                                                                        4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 *
                                                                                              (1 / d.weight +
                                                                                                    2 *
                                                                                                        (d.periodMax /
                                                                                                          ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                                      d.formBound +
                                                                                                  2 *
                                                                                                      (d.periodMax /
                                                                                                        ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                                    d.actuatorBound +
                                                                                                2 *
                                                                                                    (d.periodMax /
                                                                                                      ↑d.twist) /
                                                                                                  d.coerciveTotal) ≤
                                                                                            d.supBound ^ 2 →
                                                                                          4 * ⋯ * d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                                                4 *
                                                                                                      (d.periodMax /
                                                                                                        ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                                    d.sizeBound *
                                                                                                  (⋯ +
                                                                                                    2 *
                                                                                                        d.actuatorBound *
                                                                                                      d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                                              d.supBound ^ 2 →
                                                                                            d.slopeInverse * d.slope =
                                                                                                1 →
                                                                                              (∀ p ∈ d.box, ⋯) →
                                                                                                (∀ (i : Fin k), ⋯) →
                                                                                                  ⋯ →
                                                                                                    Breakdown.IsCertificate
                                                                                                      d

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsCellTuple.right_finite
Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSystemFacts.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {M : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.CellMesh}
  {MD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.ModelData M k} {RD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData M N}
  {Sp : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.CellSplit k N} {K₂ : Fin Sp.cellCount}
  {r : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellEntry M N k Sp.slots}
  {C : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.CellCoords k Sp.slots},
  Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.IsRowsInstance c M RD r.meshCell r.rows →
    Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
      (∀ n ∉ r.scalars.resolved, ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), r.scalars.localMatrix n p = 0) →
        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsResolvedTests α c r.scalars r.weights r.strainScalar r.lowConst →
          (r.scalars.strainBound = fun x => r.strainConst) →
            (r.scalars.meanGradBound = fun x => r.meanConst) →
              (r.scalars.waveGradBound = fun x => r.waveConst) →
                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    r.classes.strainDev i p =
                        r.devConst 0 i + r.devSlope 0 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                      r.classes.gradDev i p =
                          r.devConst 1 i + r.devSlope 1 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                        r.classes.velocityDev i p =
                            r.devConst 2 i + r.devSlope 2 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                          r.classes.curlDev i p =
                            r.devConst 3 i +
                              r.devSlope 3 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p) →
                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
                    (r.box.IsAxis → r.weights.J = 0) →
                      3 ≤ r.scalars.degLow ∧
                          r.scalars.degLow + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh ∧ r.scalars.degHigh + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                        RD.degree + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh →
                          MD.columnDegree + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                            RD.degree + MD.degree + 2 ≤ r.rowDegree →
                              0 ≤ r.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ r.waveConst →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsGivenBases r.box r.baseDegree r.givenBases →
                                  (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                          inner ℝ
                                              ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u)
                                              u ≤
                                            r.strainConst * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                    (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2)
                                            r.meanConst) →
                                      (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                            ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                (fun a b =>
                                                  ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameMat θ
                                                        (c.modelCurlGrad
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                                        a b) -
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad
                                                      p.1 p.2 a b)
                                                r.waveConst) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                            ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                              p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                        (r.classes.modes i) c.modelStrain p θ)
                                                      (r.classes.strainDev i p) ∧
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                          (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurlGrad p θ)
                                                        (r.classes.gradDev i p) ∧
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelVelocity p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2 ∧
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurl p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) →
                                          (∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                              ↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes ∧ -↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes) →
                                            r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band ⊆ r.rows.yModes →
                                              (∀ a ∈ r.rows.rowSet, r.rows.rowModeOf a ∈ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (n : ℤ),
                                                    n ∈ r.classes.modes i ↔ -n ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                  (∀ (i j : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                      i ≠ j → Disjoint (r.classes.modes i) (r.classes.modes j)) →
                                                    (∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                        ∀ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                          ∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                                            ↑β ≤ MD.harmonicsOf r.meshCell →
                                                              n - n' = ↑↑β ∨ n - n' = -↑↑β →
                                                                ∃ i, n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                      (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                          r.classes.resolvedPart i ⊆ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                            ∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                              (∃ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                                  n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                                n ∈ r.classes.resolvedPart i) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                              0 < r.classes.shareWeight i ∧ 0 < r.classes.rowWeight i) →
                                                            (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                                                0 ≤ r.classes.strainDev i p ∧
                                                                  0 ≤ r.classes.gradDev i p ∧
                                                                    0 ≤ r.classes.velocityDev i p ∧
                                                                      0 ≤ r.classes.curlDev i p) →
                                                              (∀ p ∈ r.box.rect,
                                                                  ∑ i,
                                                                        1 / 2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                              r.classes.gradDev i p *
                                                                            r.scalars.splitLength /
                                                                          r.classes.shareWeight i ≤
                                                                      r.scalars.penaltyStrain ∧
                                                                    ∑ i,
                                                                          (r.classes.strainDev i p /
                                                                              r.classes.shareWeight i +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyCurl ∧
                                                                      ∑ i,
                                                                          (1 / 2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                                r.classes.gradDev i p /
                                                                              (r.scalars.splitLength *
                                                                                r.classes.shareWeight i) +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyVelocity) →
                                                                0 < r.rows.farShare ∧ r.rows.farShare < 1 →
                                                                  (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                      RD.cell a = RD.cell b →
                                                                        RD.harmonic a = RD.harmonic b →
                                                                          (a ∈ r.rows.rowSet ↔ b ∈ r.rows.rowSet)) →
                                                                    r.rows.multiplierMatrix =
                                                                        RD.mix *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testMultiplierOf
                                                                              c RD r *
                                                                          RD.mix.transpose →
                                                                      r.rows.reducer =
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testReducerOf c
                                                                              RD r *

declarations.type:
{K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
  {resolved : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} →
    {coef : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ × ℝ → Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients} →
      {ch : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges} →
        {T : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.LeafValues} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsLeafValues K resolved coef ch T → Sort u} →
            ((hessFloor_pos : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 < T.hessFloor ι) →
                (hessFloor_le : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.hessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).hess) →
                  (curlHessFloor_nonneg : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 ≤ T.curlHessFloor ι) →
                    (curlHessFloor_le : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.curlHessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).curlHess) →
                      (matrix_hermitian : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, (T.localMatrix ι p).IsHermitian) →
                        (matrix_regular :
                            ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                              (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => T.localMatrix ι p i j) ∧
                                ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖T.localMatrix ι p i j‖ ≤ C) →
                          (matrix_le :
                              ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                  ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.coefPairValue (coef ι p) s v -
                                        T.boxPenalty ι s v) →
                            (pointwise :
                                ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                    p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                      ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                        0 ≤
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) -
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss (ch.curl ι p)
                                                    (ch.product ι p) (ch.gradient ι p) (ch.length ι p) s v -
                                                T.boxPairPenalty ι s v) +
                                            T.absorbValue ι s v) →
                              (charges_nonneg :
                                  ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p ∧ 0 < ch.length ι p) →
                                (symmetric :
                                    ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                      T.hessFloor (-ι) = T.hessFloor ι ∧
                                        T.curlHessFloor (-ι) = T.curlHessFloor ι ∧
                                          T.curlAbsorb (-ι) = T.curlAbsorb ι ∧
                                            T.strainAbsorb (-ι) = T.strainAbsorb ι ∧
                                              T.velocityAbsorb (-ι) = T.velocityAbsorb ι) →
                                  motive ⋯) →
              (t : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsLeafValues K resolved coef ch T) → motive t

              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowsEliminated D K (A.blocks K) x) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            (∀ (j : Fin 9), 0 < (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) ∧
              ∀ (b : Fin 3), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑b, ⋯⟩) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
              Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ι ≠ 0 ∧
                Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ι ^ 2 ≠ 1) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).bandSlack ∧ (A.blocks K).bandSlack < 1) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                (A.blocks K).bandSlack = 0 →
                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,

                            ↑((A.blocks K).bandWeight ι (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) *

                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                    ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                      (∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),

                              (A.blocks K).pairingSource ι d p j) ∧
                          (∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p => (A.blocks K).bandMap ι d p j) ∧
                            ∀ (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),

∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k} {j : Fin k} {r : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectEntry k},
  (∀ i ∈ d.adjointSet, d.radius i ≤ r.coordBound i) →
    (∀ i ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ, d.scale i ≠ 0 ∧ |d.stiffRadius| ≤ |d.scale i| * r.coordBound i) →
      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms r.centrePotential r.centreNumbers →
        (∀ q ∈ d.params,
            Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
              (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.centreResidual q) r.pinFlux r.centrePotential)
              r.centreNumbers.remainder) →
          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet, Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms (r.fittedPotential i) (r.fittedNumbers i)) →
            (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet,
                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.fittedResidual i) (fun x x_1 => 0)
                    (r.fittedPotential i))
                  (r.fittedNumbers i).remainder) →
              (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, 0 < r.freeWeight i) →
                0 ≤ r.freeValue →
                  0 ≤ r.freeDual →
                    (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                            (∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * ‖r.free q i σ y‖ ^ 2) * ‖r.field σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                          ENNReal.ofReal (r.freeValue ^ 2)) →
                      (∃ δ,
                          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ,
                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                                  (fun σ y =>
                                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.transposeApply (fderiv ℝ (r.free q i σ) y) (r.field σ y))
                                  (δ i)) ∧
                            ∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * δ i ^ 2 ≤ r.freeDual ^ 2) →
                        Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative r.field)
                            r.timeDual →
                          0 ≤ r.pinError →
                            0 ≤ r.pinRound →
                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                    ‖∑ l, r.pinCoef l • (r.pins.potential l σ y - r.pins.generator l σ y)‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                  ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinError ^ 2) →
                                (∀ (c : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                        Breakdown.matSq
                                          (∑ l, c l • (d.pin l σ y - fderiv ℝ (r.pins.potential l σ) y))) ≤
                                      ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinRound ^ 2 * ∑ l, c l ^ 2)) →
                                  √(∑ l, r.pinCoef l ^ 2) ≤ r.pinCoefNorm →
                                    r.defectSum d.weight + r.pinCharge d.weight ≤ d.adjointDefect j →
                                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded d j r

declarations.type:
{C : Type} →
  {nE nM : ℕ} →
    {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} →
      {P : ℝ} →
        {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds} →
          {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
              {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ} →
                {motive :
                    Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
                      Sort u} →
                  ((ampW_ge :
                        ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                      (ampGradW_ge :
                          ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                h.ampGradW β y) →
                        (ampVort_ge :
                            ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                      (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                  h.ampVort β y) →
                          (ampGradVort_ge :
                              ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                        (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                    h.ampGradVort β y) →
                            (supVort_ge :
                                ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                              (supGradVort_ge :
                                  ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                      h.supGradVort y) →
                                (epsSpeed_ge :
                                    ∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                            (m.epsP β).frame •
                                              (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                        (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                  (muSpeed_ge :
                                      ∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                              (m.muP β).frame •
                                                (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                  (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                          (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                    (eps_oneSided :
                                        ∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                          ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                            ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                              Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                      (mu_oneSided :
                                          ∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                            ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                              ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                        (mu_ratio :
                                            ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                              (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                  2 ≤
                                                ratio *
                                                  ∑ β,
                                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                        |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                      (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                          (ratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ ratio) →
                                            (eps_sum_le : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                              (eps_grad_sum_le :
                                                  ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                                                (conv_le :
                                                    ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                                  motive ⋯) →
                    (t :
                        Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup
                          ratio) →
                      motive t

                            ∀ (n : ℤ),
                              S.curlAbsorb n =
                                if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl
                                else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
                          (strain_form :
                              ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                S.strainAbsorb n =
                                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                                  else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                            (velocity_form :
                                ∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                              (sym_form :
                                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                    S.symWeight n j l =
                                      S.energyWeight n *
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                              K.angularWeight n *
                                                max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^ 2) -
                                          S.strainAbsorb n -
                                        S.tailShift n) →
                                (anti_form :
                                    ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                      S.antiWeight n j l =
                                        (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                  K.angularWeight n *
                                                    max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^
                                                      2) -
                                              2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                  (vel_form :
                                      ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                        S.velWeight n j l =
                                          (S.tailShift n *
                                              if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                              else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                                            S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                    motive ⋯) →
              (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W) → motive t

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {Tb : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.FarFieldValueSets},
  Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.IsChartParams Tb.chart →
    (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
        ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
          inner ℝ
              ((Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf D.given σ (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                u)
              u ≤
            Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.strain
                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) *
              ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
      (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.opBound
            (fun a b =>
              Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)
                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess) p (a, b))
            (Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p))) →
        (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖(Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess σ
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                      u -
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellMatField.frameMap θ fun a b =>
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess) p (a, b)).re)
                      u‖ ≤
                Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) *
                  ‖u‖) →
          (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
              ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                (D.charges none).curl ι p =
                    Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.strain
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                  (D.charges none).product ι p =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                    (D.charges none).gradient ι p =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p)) →
            (∀ (ι ι' : ℤ × ℤ),
                ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                  (D.charges none).length ι p = (D.charges none).length ι' p) →
              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane, 0 < (D.charges none).length ι p) →
                (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                    0 ≤
                        Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                      0 ≤
                        Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p)) →
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.FarFieldConditions D Tb

                            0 < S.splitLength →

                                0 ≤ S.penaltyStrain ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyCurl ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyVelocity →

                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax)))
                                            (W.rHi *
                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax))) ≤
                                          W.strainBase →

                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K

declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L →
    (∀ n ∈ L.modes, -n ∈ L.modes) →
      (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
          (L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                K.z₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
            ¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
        (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
            ((L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.presSegment s).level) ∧
              (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.presSegment s).level)) →
          (∀ (e : Fin 4),
              (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                ∀ (u : ℝ),
                  (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂ else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                    ∃ s,
                      ((L.presSegment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                        ((L.presSegment s).level =
                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁ else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) ∧
                          (L.presSegment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.presSegment s).hi) →
            (∀ (s s' : Fin L.presCount),
                s ≠ s' →
                  (L.presSegment s).radial = (L.presSegment s').radial →
                    (L.presSegment s).level = (L.presSegment s').level →
                      (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ (L.presSegment s').lo ∨ (L.presSegment s').hi ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo) →
              (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                  d < L.degSide →
                    d' < L.degSide →
                      ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.presSegment s).lo (L.presSegment s).hi,
                          (L.presSegment s).test d u * (L.presSegment s).test d' u =
                        if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L

        (∀ (j : A ⊕ B), 0 < D.weight j) →

            E.transpose = E →

                        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue

                                Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.pivotDiagonal (Finset.univ \ T.pivots ν) D.radius)
                              x +
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i => |x i|) →

                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                        K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -

                                                                  W.shift) →
                                                            (sym_resolved_height :
                                                                S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                  W.energy *
                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                          K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                      W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                    W.shift) →

                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam

                                                                        (anti_out :
                                                                            S.weightFloor ≤

                                                                                (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.rec
declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
          {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L → Sort u} →
              ((order_eq : L.order = c.order) →
                  (box_eq : L.box = K) →
                    (bases_eq : L.bases = B) →
                      (modes_eq : L.modes = S.resolved) →
                        (degCoef_eq : L.degCoef = S.degHigh) →
                          (degSide_eq : L.degSide = S.degLow) →
                            (box_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K) →
                              (bases_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B) →
                                (segment_valid :
                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                                  (presSegment_valid :
                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                                    (gauge_valid :
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧
                                          L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo) →
                                      (segment_on_side :
                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                            (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧
                                                    (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                                              ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                                        (segment_other_in_box :
                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                              ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                  (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                  (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                                          (corner_is_corner :
                                              ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                                  ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧
                                                    (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                                            (corner_other :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                  (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                                    (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                              (segEnd_spec :
                                                  ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                    L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                                      L.corner c =
                                                        if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                                          ((L.segment s).level,
                                                            if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                                        else
                                                          (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi,
                                                            (L.segment s).level)) →
                                                (segEnd_axis :
                                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                                      L.segEnd s e = none →
                                                        ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                                  (radial_test_const :
                                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                        (L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                    (height_test_affine :
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (degSide_pos : 1 ≤ L.degSide) →
                                                        (degSide_le : L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef) →
                                                          (cellCorner_spec :
                                                              ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                                L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                                  L.corner c =
                                                                    (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂,
                                                                      if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                                            (cellCorner_axis :
                                                                ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                  L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                              (sideSegments_spec :
                                                                  ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                    ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                      ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                                        (L.segment s).level =
                                                                          if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                                          else
                                                                            if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂
                                                                            else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                                (sideSegments_cover :
                                                                    ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                      (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                                        ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                                          (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                                            else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                                            ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                              (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧
                                                                                u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                                  (sideSegments_disjoint :
                                                                      ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                        ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                          ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                            s ≠ s' →
                                                                              (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                                (L.segment s').hi ≤ (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                                    (segments_on_sides :
                                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                                          ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                                      (segment_orthonormal :
                                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                                            d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                              d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                ∫ (u : ℝ) in
                                                                                    Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo
                                                                                      (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                                    (L.segment s).test d u *
                                                                                      (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                                  if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                                        motive ⋯) →
                (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) → motive t

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {X : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.ExteriorCover C nE nM},
  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
      ∀ (i : Fin X.rayCount),
        Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsExteriorCondition (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn
          (D.charges none) D.azimuthOrder (X.rayConditions i)) →
    (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
        ∀ (j : Fin X.pointCount),
          Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsOffModeCondition (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn
            (D.charges none) D.azimuthOrder (X.pointConditions j)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin X.rayCount), (X.rayConditions i).charges = X.charges) →
        (∀ (j : Fin X.pointCount), (X.pointConditions j).charges = X.charges) →
          (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, ι ∈ X.modes a) →
            X.charges.Covers (D.charges none) Set.univ (D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane) →
              (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ X.charges.curlCharge p ∧ 0 ≤ X.charges.gradCharge p ∧ 0 ≤ X.charges.velCharge p) →
                (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane ⊆ ⋃ a ∈ X.parts ι, X.region a) →
                  (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                      ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, ∀ b ∈ X.parts ι, a ≠ b → MeasureTheory.volume (X.region a ∩ X.region b) = 0) →
                    (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, X.region a ⊆ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin X.rayCount ⊕ Fin X.pointCount), MeasurableSet (X.region a)) →
                        (Measurable X.charges.curlCharge ∧
                            Measurable X.charges.gradCharge ∧
                              Measurable X.charges.velCharge ∧
                                ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                  Measurable ((D.charges none).curl ι) ∧
                                    Measurable ((D.charges none).product ι) ∧
                                      Measurable ((D.charges none).gradient ι) ∧
                                        Measurable ((D.charges none).length ι)) →
                          (∃ c,
                              ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                                |X.charges.curlCharge p| ≤ c ∧
                                  |X.charges.gradCharge p| ≤ c ∧
                                    |X.charges.velCharge p| ≤ c ∧
                                      |X.charges.stretchConst| ≤ c ∧
                                        ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                          |(D.charges none).curl ι p| ≤ c ∧
                                            |(D.charges none).product ι p| ≤ c ∧
                                              |(D.charges none).gradient ι p| ≤ c ∧
                                                (D.charges none).gradient ι p * (D.charges none).length ι p ≤ c ∧
                                                  (D.charges none).gradient ι p * ((D.charges none).length ι p)⁻¹ ≤ c) →

declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {Q : Fin D.mesh.count → Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingData k} →
              {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S → Sort u} →
                  ((mesh_valid : Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh) →
                      (cell_conditions : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R) →
                        (kept_le :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                              S K x →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
                          (source_eq :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                    S K x →
                                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                        ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec
                                              (fun a b =>
                                                1 / 2 *
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                                              0) →
                            (source_zero :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                                      ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                        S K x →
                                          ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                                              0) →
                              (gamma_resolved :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                      ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                                        (∃ g a b,
                                            ¬(fun p =>
                                                  R.pairProfile K g ι p a
                                                    b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                                0) →
                                          ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                                            0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                              (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                                                ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                  (∑ a,
                                                      ∑ b,
                                                        (D.mesh.box K).tailNormSq ((R.layouts K).layout ι).degCoef
                                                          fun p =>
                                                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat
                                                                (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                              (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>
                                                      ↑(w g)) →
                                (gamma_other :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                                        ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                                          ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                            (∃ g a b,
                                                ¬(fun p =>
                                                      R.pairProfile K g ι p a
                                                        b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                                    0) →
                                              ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                                                ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes ∧
                                                  0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                                    (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧
                                                      ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                            p.1 *
                                                              ∑ a,
                                                                ∑ b,
                                                                  ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                                        (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b‖ ^
                                                                    2 ≤
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι)
                                                            fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                                  (gamma_gram :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                                          0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                            ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                              0 ≤
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>
                                                  ↑(w g)) →
                                    (leak_nonneg :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι) →
                                      (cost_nonneg :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι) →
                                        motive ⋯) →
                    (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S) → motive t
