declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSystemFacts.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {M : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.CellMesh}
  {MD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.ModelData M k} {RD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData M N}
  {Sp : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.CellSplit k N} {K₂ : Fin Sp.cellCount}
  {r : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellEntry M N k Sp.slots}
  {C : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.CellCoords k Sp.slots},
  Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.IsRowsInstance c M RD r.meshCell r.rows →
    Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
      (∀ n ∉ r.scalars.resolved, ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), r.scalars.localMatrix n p = 0) →
        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsResolvedTests α c r.scalars r.weights r.strainScalar r.lowConst →
          (r.scalars.strainBound = fun x => r.strainConst) →
            (r.scalars.meanGradBound = fun x => r.meanConst) →
              (r.scalars.waveGradBound = fun x => r.waveConst) →
                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    r.classes.strainDev i p =
                        r.devConst 0 i + r.devSlope 0 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                      r.classes.gradDev i p =
                          r.devConst 1 i + r.devSlope 1 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                        r.classes.velocityDev i p =
                            r.devConst 2 i + r.devSlope 2 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                          r.classes.curlDev i p =
                            r.devConst 3 i +
                              r.devSlope 3 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p) →
                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
                    (r.box.IsAxis → r.weights.J = 0) →
                      3 ≤ r.scalars.degLow ∧
                          r.scalars.degLow + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh ∧ r.scalars.degHigh + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                        RD.degree + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh →
                          MD.columnDegree + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                            RD.degree + MD.degree + 2 ≤ r.rowDegree →
                              0 ≤ r.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ r.waveConst →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsGivenBases r.box r.baseDegree r.givenBases →
                                  (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                          inner ℝ
                                              ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u)
                                              u ≤
                                            r.strainConst * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                    (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2)
                                            r.meanConst) →
                                      (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                            ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                (fun a b =>
                                                  ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameMat θ
                                                        (c.modelCurlGrad
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                                        a b) -
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad
                                                      p.1 p.2 a b)
                                                r.waveConst) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                            ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                              p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                        (r.classes.modes i) c.modelStrain p θ)
                                                      (r.classes.strainDev i p) ∧
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                          (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurlGrad p θ)
                                                        (r.classes.gradDev i p) ∧
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelVelocity p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2 ∧
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurl p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) →
                                          (∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                              ↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes ∧ -↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes) →
                                            r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band ⊆ r.rows.yModes →
                                              (∀ a ∈ r.rows.rowSet, r.rows.rowModeOf a ∈ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (n : ℤ),
                                                    n ∈ r.classes.modes i ↔ -n ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                  (∀ (i j : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                      i ≠ j → Disjoint (r.classes.modes i) (r.classes.modes j)) →
                                                    (∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                        ∀ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                          ∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                                            ↑β ≤ MD.harmonicsOf r.meshCell →
                                                              n - n' = ↑↑β ∨ n - n' = -↑↑β →
                                                                ∃ i, n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                      (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                          r.classes.resolvedPart i ⊆ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                            ∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                              (∃ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                                  n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                                n ∈ r.classes.resolvedPart i) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                              0 < r.classes.shareWeight i ∧ 0 < r.classes.rowWeight i) →
                                                            (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                                                0 ≤ r.classes.strainDev i p ∧
                                                                  0 ≤ r.classes.gradDev i p ∧
                                                                    0 ≤ r.classes.velocityDev i p ∧
                                                                      0 ≤ r.classes.curlDev i p) →
                                                              (∀ p ∈ r.box.rect,
                                                                  ∑ i,
                                                                        1 / 2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                              r.classes.gradDev i p *
                                                                            r.scalars.splitLength /
                                                                          r.classes.shareWeight i ≤
                                                                      r.scalars.penaltyStrain ∧
                                                                    ∑ i,
                                                                          (r.classes.strainDev i p /
                                                                              r.classes.shareWeight i +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyCurl ∧
                                                                      ∑ i,
                                                                          (1 / 2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                                r.classes.gradDev i p /
                                                                              (r.scalars.splitLength *
                                                                                r.classes.shareWeight i) +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyVelocity) →
                                                                0 < r.rows.farShare ∧ r.rows.farShare < 1 →
                                                                  (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                      RD.cell a = RD.cell b →
                                                                        RD.harmonic a = RD.harmonic b →
                                                                          (a ∈ r.rows.rowSet ↔ b ∈ r.rows.rowSet)) →
                                                                    r.rows.multiplierMatrix =
                                                                        RD.mix *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testMultiplierOf
                                                                              c RD r *
                                                                          RD.mix.transpose →
                                                                      r.rows.reducer =
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testReducerOf c
                                                                              RD r *
                                                                            RD.mix⁻¹ →
                                                                        r.systemMultiplier.IsSymm →
                                                                          (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                              a ∉ r.rows.rowSet ∨ b ∉ r.rows.rowSet →
                                                                                r.systemMultiplier a b = 0) →
                                                                            (∀ a ∈ r.rows.rowSet,
                                                                                r.rows.classRowWeight a = ⋯) →
                                                                              (∀ (μ : Fin N → ℝ),
                                                                                  (∀ a ∉ r.rows.rowSet, μ a = 0) → ⋯) →
                                                                                0 < r.far.share →
                                                                                  0 ≤ r.far.turnBound → ⋯

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.mk
declarations.type:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X] →
      [inst_2 : CompleteSpace X] →
        (F : Breakdown.MildFramework X) →
          (rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X) →
            (∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R)) →
              (embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X) →
                (∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g) →
                  (∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                        ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2) →
                    (∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0) →
                      (∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                          Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)) →
                        (∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            0 < μ → Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)) →
                          (∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                              a < b →
                                (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                  ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                        ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                            MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                      (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                          Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                            (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                        (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                            Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                              ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                  (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                    Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                  t) →
                                          (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                            F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b) →
                            (test : Submodule ℝ X) →
                              Dense ↑test →
                                (∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x) → Breakdown.Realization X

                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.opBound
                            (fun a b =>

    (∀ (ν : T.Node), (T.front ν).transpose = T.front ν) →
      (∀ (ν μ : T.Node), T.parent ν = some μ → T.rank ν < T.rank μ) →
        T.parent T.root = none →
          (∀ (ν : T.Node), T.parent ν = none → ν = T.root) →
            (∀ (ν μ : T.Node), ν ≠ μ → Disjoint (T.eliminated ν) (T.eliminated μ)) →
              (∀ (ν : T.Node) (x y : Fin a ⊕ Fin b → ℝ),
                  (∀ i ∉ T.eliminated ν, x (Sum.inl i) = y (Sum.inl i)) →
                    (∀ (j : Fin b), x (Sum.inr j) = y (Sum.inr j)) →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x =
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) y) →
                (∀ (ν : T.Node) (x : Fin a ⊕ Fin b → ℝ),
                    Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x) →
                  (∀ (x y : Fin a ⊕ Fin b → ℝ),
                      (∀ (i : Fin a), ¬T.IsEliminatedSomewhere i → x (Sum.inl i) = y (Sum.inl i)) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin b), x (Sum.inr j) = y (Sum.inr j)) →
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front T.root + T.globalForm) x =
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front T.root + T.globalForm) y) →
                    (∃ P ≤ T.rootSpace,
                        Nat.card { i // ¬T.IsEliminatedSomewhere i } ≤ Module.finrank ℝ ↥P ∧

declarations.type:
∀ {count : ℕ} {box : Fin count → Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} {m : ℕ} {K : Fin count} {deg : ℕ}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {model : Breakdown.CertCell.ModelPolys count} {err : Breakdown.CertCell.ModelErrors}
  {high : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelHigh} {long : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelLong},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K) W
      (model.velocity.field box m) high.velocity long.velocity err.velocityHigh long.errVelocity err.velocity →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
        (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityOf W) (model.vorticity.field box m) high.vorticity long.vorticity
        err.vorticityHigh long.errVorticity err.vorticity →
      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
          (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W) (model.strain.field box m) high.strain long.strain err.strainHigh
          long.errStrain err.strain →
        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPartAE (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) (model.vorticityGrad.field box m) high.vorticityGrad
            long.vorticityGrad err.vorticityGradHigh long.errVorticityGrad err.vorticityGrad →
          (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ),
              |α.1| ≤ 2 * ↑long.cut →
                ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                  (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.velocity p a = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.vorticity p a = 0) ∧
                      (∀ (a b : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.strain p (a, b) = 0) ∧
                        ∀ (a b : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.vorticityGrad p (a, b) = 0) →
            ContinuousOn (fun z => long.velocity z.1 z.2)
                  {z |
                    0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                ContinuousOn (fun z => long.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                    {z |
                      0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.strain z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
              (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (long.strain σ y) = long.strain σ y) →
                0 ≤ long.errVelocity ∧ 0 ≤ long.errVorticity ∧ 0 ≤ long.errStrain ∧ 0 ≤ long.errVorticityGrad →
                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsVecOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.velocity →
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsVecOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.vorticity →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.strain →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.vorticityGrad →
                          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (high.strain σ y) = high.strain σ y) →
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.velocity z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                                    MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.strain z.1 z.2)
                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2)
                                      MeasureTheory.volume →
                              model.velocity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                  model.vorticity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                    model.strain.IsConjugateClosed box ∧ model.vorticityGrad.IsConjugateClosed box →
                                0 ≤ err.velocity ∧
                                    0 ≤ err.vorticity ∧
                                      0 ≤ err.strain ∧

                                          0 ≤ err.velocityHigh ∧

  R.testPairing.PosDef →
    (∀ (a : Fin N),
        Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.IsSolenoidalProfile (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth m ↑(R.harmonic a))
          (R.profile a)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin M.cellCount), 0 < R.cellWeight K) →
        (∀ (K : Fin M.cellCount), R.cellWeight K ≤ rowMax) →
          (∀ (a : Fin N), (M.box (R.cell a)).r₁ = 0 → R.harmonic a = 0) →
            (∀ (a : Fin N),
                (M.box (R.cell a)).r₁ = 0 → ∀ (l : Fin (R.degree + 1)), R.profile a 0 0 l = 0 ∧ R.profile a 1 0 l = 0) →
              (∀ (a : Fin N) (j : Fin (R.degree + 1)),
                  R.profile a 0 j (Fin.last R.degree) = 0 ∧ R.profile a 2 (Fin.last R.degree) j = 0) →
                (∀ (a : Fin N), R.partner (R.partner a) = a) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin N), R.cell (R.partner a) = R.cell a) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin N), R.harmonic (R.partner a) = R.harmonic a) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin N), R.harmonic a = 0 → R.partner a = a) →
                        (∀ (a : Fin N), R.harmonic a ≠ 0 → R.positive (R.partner a) = !R.positive a) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin N),
                              R.harmonic a ≠ 0 →
                                R.positive a = true →
                                  ∀ (c : Fin 3) (j l : Fin (R.degree + 1)),
                                    R.profile (R.partner a) c j l = Complex.I * R.profile a c j l) →
                            Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.IsRowData R m rowMax

  3 ≤ d.order →
    0 < d.coercivity →
      d.coercivity < d.splitVisc →
        0 < d.pinWeight →
          0 < d.rowMax →
            0 < d.multiplierScale →
              (∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                (∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                  0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius →
                    (∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                      (∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ), |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                        d.frameDefect < 1 →
                          ∑ l, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                              d.pinGap ^ 2 →
                            0 ≤ d.pinGap →
                              0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss →
                                0 < d.reducedCoercivity →
                                  d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss →
                                    (∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                        0 < κ₀ →
                                          max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤
                                            d.lowLoss * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2)) →
                                      0 < d.reducedGap →
                                        0 ≤ d.formScale →
                                          (∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                              0 < κ₀ →
                                                1 ≤
                                                  d.formScale ^ 2 *
                                                    (κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1)) - d.splitVisc +
                                                      d.reducedCoercivity * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2))) →
                                            0 ≤ d.splitBound →
                                              d.contraction < 1 →
                                                0 ≤ d.productConst →
                                                  (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.projectedNorm (d.defect α p) ≤
                                                        d.defectBound) →
                                                    (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                        d.rowsModGrad (d.defect α p) ≤ d.defectRowBound) →
                                                      d.boundFn d.defectBound d.defectRowBound 0 ≤ d.sizeBound →
                                                        4 * d.rowConst * d.productConst * d.sizeBound < 1 →
                                                          (∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                              ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                            (∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                  ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                    d.adjointQuad j p * d.heldRadius ^ 2 +
                                                                          d.heldRadius *
                                                                            √((d.adjointLocal j p +
                                                                                      d.adjointSpread j p +
                                                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                          (d.adjointPin j p) *
                                                                                        d.pinGap /
                                                                                      √d.weightMin) ^
                                                                                  2 +
                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                      (d.adjointError j p) ^
                                                                                    2 /
                                                                                  d.multiplierScale ^ 2) +
                                                                        |d.adjustedMultiplier α p' j| ≤
                                                                      |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                                              (∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                  √(1 + d.frameDefect) * d.heldRadius /
                                                                        d.multiplierScale +
                                                                      √(∑ j ∈ d.activeSetᶜ,
                                                                          (d.frame.transpose.mulVec (d.multiplier p')
                                                                                j -
                                                                              d.slope j * p' j) ^
                                                                            2) ≤
                                                                    d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                                                                (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                    d.heldRadius / √d.weightMin <
                                                                      √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                            (d.gradProfile p y))) →

                (multiplierWeight_pos : 0 < d.multiplierWeight) →
                  (coerciveL2_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.coerciveL2) →
                    (coercivePin_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.coercivePin) →
                      (rowBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.rowBound) →
                        (gapSize_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.gapSize) →
                          (formShift_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formShift) →
                            (transfer_lt : d.transferLoss < 1) →
                              (coerciveTotal_ge : d.coerciveL2 + d.rowBound ≤ (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.coerciveTotal) →
                                (coerciveTotal_pos : 0 < d.coerciveTotal) →
                                  (actuatorBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.actuatorBound) →
                                    (modelFormBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.modelFormBound) →
                                      (formBound_ge : d.modelFormBound + d.formShift ≤ d.formBound) →
                                        (sizeBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.sizeBound) →
                                          (supBound_pos : 0 < d.supBound) →
                                            (period_le : ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.period q ≤ d.periodMax) →
                                              (twist_pos : 0 < d.twist) →
                                                (twist_mem :
                                                    d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                                  (actuator_norm :
                                                      (∑ i,
                                                          Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖d.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                        ENNReal.ofReal (d.actuatorBound ^ 2)) →
                                                    (defect_nonneg :
                                                        ∀ q ∈ d.params, 0 ≤ d.defectBound q ∧ 0 ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                      (defect_l2 :
                                                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                ‖d.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                              ENNReal.ofReal (d.defectBound q ^ 2)) →
                                                        (defect_rows :
                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.rows (d.defect q) ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                          (defect_le : ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.defectBound q ≤ d.defectMax) →
                                                            (size :
                                                                ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                  d.coerciveL2 * d.defectBound q + d.defectRowBound q +
                                                                      d.coercivePin *
                                                                        Breakdown.vecNorm (d.targetGap q) ≤
                                                                    (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.sizeBound) →
                                                              (small_first :
                                                                  2 * d.coerciveTotal *
                                                                        Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                      d.supBound <
                                                                    1) →
                                                                (small_second :
                                                                    4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 *
                                                                        (1 / d.weight +
                                                                              2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                d.formBound +
                                                                            2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                              (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) +
                                                                          2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) /
                                                                            d.coerciveTotal) ≤
                                                                      d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                  (small_third :
                                                                      4 *
                                                                              (1 / d.weight +
                                                                                2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                  d.formBound) *
                                                                            d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                          4 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.sizeBound *
                                                                            (d.defectMax +
                                                                                2 * Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                                    d.sizeBound *
                                                                                  d.supBound +
                                                                              2 *
                                                                                  (d.actuatorBound /
                                                                                    d.multiplierWeight) *
                                                                                d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                        d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                    (frame_unit : IsUnit d.frame) →
                                                                      (adjoint_l2 :
                                                                          ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                              ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                                                                ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                    ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                      (‖d.adjoint j q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                                  ENNReal.ofReal (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →
                                                                        (adjointL2_nonneg :
                                                                            ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointL2 j) →
                                                                          (adjointDefect_nonneg :
                                                                              ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                0 ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                                            (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                                ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                  0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j) →
                                                                              (adjoint_inclusion :
                                                                                  ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                    ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                      d.adjointQuad j *
                                                                                              (2 * d.sizeBound) ^ 2 +
                                                                                            2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                              √(d.adjointDefect j ^ 2 +
                                                                                                  (Breakdown.vecNorm
                                                                                                        (d.actuatorAdjointError
                                                                                                          q j) /
                                                                                                      d.multiplierWeight) ^
                                                                                                    2) +
                                                                                          d.adjointOffset j ≤
                                                                                        |d.scale j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                                (stiffNorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.stiffNorm) →
                                                                                  (stiff_norm :
                                                                                      ∀ (x : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                                                        ∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                            (∑ i, d.frame i j * x i) ^
                                                                                              2 ≤
                                                                                          d.stiffNorm ^ 2 *
                                                                                            ∑ i, x i ^ 2) →
                                                                                    (stiff_offset :
                                                                                        ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                          √(∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                                (∑ i,
                                                                                                      d.frame i j *
                                                                                                        d.multiplier q
                                                                                                          i -
                                                                                                    d.scale j * q j) ^
                                                                                                  2) ≤
                                                                                            d.stiffOffset) →
                                                                                      (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                                          2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                                  d.stiffNorm /
                                                                                                d.multiplierWeight +
                                                                                              d.stiffOffset ≤
                                                                                            d.stiffRadius) →
                                                                                        (nontrivial :
                                                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                              4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 /
                                                                                                  d.weight <
                                                                                                (Breakdown.periodLIntegral
                                                                                                    fun σ y =>
                                                                                                    ⋯).toReal) →

declarations.type:
{C : Type} →
  {nE nM : ℕ} →
    {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} →
      {P : ℝ} →
        {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds} →
          {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
              {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ} →
                {motive :
                    Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
                      Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio) →
                    ((ampW_ge :
                          ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                        (ampGradW_ge :
                            ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                  h.ampGradW β y) →
                          (ampVort_ge :
                              ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                        (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                    h.ampVort β y) →
                            (ampGradVort_ge :
                                ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                  ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                          (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                      h.ampGradVort β y) →
                              (supVort_ge :
                                  ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                                (supGradVort_ge :
                                    ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                        h.supGradVort y) →
                                  (epsSpeed_ge :
                                      ∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                              (m.epsP β).frame •
                                                (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                  (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                          (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                    (muSpeed_ge :
                                        ∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                (m.muP β).frame •
                                                  (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                    (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                            (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                      (eps_oneSided :
                                          ∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                            ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                              ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                                Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                        (mu_oneSided :
                                            ∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                              ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                  Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                          (mu_ratio :
                                              ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                    2 ≤
                                                  ratio *
                                                    ∑ β,
                                                      |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                        (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                            (ratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ ratio) →
                                              (eps_sum_le : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                                (eps_grad_sum_le :
                                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                                                  (conv_le :
                                                      ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                        m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                                    motive ⋯) →
                      motive t

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∀ ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
        ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            (((∑ i,
                      if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                        (P.potential K).groupStrain i / (P.potential K).groupBalance i
                      else 0) +
                    if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι else 0) +
                  if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                    (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longStrain +
                      (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl
                  else 0) ≤
                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
              ((((∑ i,
                          if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                            (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).length * (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                              (P.potential K).groupBalance i
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι else 0) +
                      if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) +
                    if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longGrad) *
                            (P.potential K).epsLength +
                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel)
                    else 0) ≤
                  (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
                (((∑ i,
                          if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                            (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                              ((P.potential K).length * (P.potential K).groupBalance i)
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakVel ι else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then

declarations.type:
{m : ℕ} →
  {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
    {resolved : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} →
      {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
        {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
          {ch : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsChargeBound m K resolved W HW ch → Sort u} →
              (t : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsChargeBound m K resolved W HW ch) →
                ((strain :
                      ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                          ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                            inner ℝ
                                ((Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W σ
                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                  u)
                                u ≤
                              ch.curl ι p * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                    (mean_gradient :
                        ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                          ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.opBound
                              (fun a b =>
                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m (0, 0)
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) p (a, b))
                              (ch.product ι p)) →
                      (wave_gradient :
                          ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                              ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                ‖(Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW σ
                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                        u -
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.CellMatField.frameMap θ fun a b =>
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m (0, 0)
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) p (a, b)).re)
                                        u‖ ≤
                                  ch.gradient ι p * ‖u‖) →
                        motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialSeries.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotentialSeries},
  (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
      ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
        Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialScalar 2 2 ((F.data κ).theta c)) →
    (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
        ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
          Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialScalar 2 1 ((F.data κ).phi c)) →
      (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
          κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
            ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
              1 ≤ ((F.data κ).theta c).axisPower ∨ Breakdown.PotentialShape.AxisCellsVanish ((F.data κ).theta c).amp) →
        (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
            κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
              ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                1 ≤ ((F.data κ).phi c).axisPower ∨ Breakdown.PotentialShape.AxisCellsVanish ((F.data κ).phi c).amp) →
          (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
              ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetAxis ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.tAxis 0 1 ∧
                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsJetMesh ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.xAxis (-1) 1) →
            (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsJetMesh ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.tAxis 0 1 ∧
                    Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetAxis ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.xAxis (-1) 1) →
              (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                  ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                    (∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
                        2 ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp z) ∧
                      ∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
                        2 ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp z) →
                (∀ κ ∈ F.keys, Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetClass 0 0 (F.data κ).pressure.amp) →
                  (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                      ∃ z ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.amp.tAxis.depth,
                        2 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.highOrder + z ∧
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder (F.data κ).pressure.amp z) →
                    (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                        κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
                          1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.axisPower ∧
                            (1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.lowOrder ∨
                              Breakdown.PotentialShape.StartVanishOrder (F.data κ).pressure.amp 1)) →
                      (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                          κ.label.1 = 0 →
                            1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.lowOrder ∨
                              Breakdown.PotentialShape.StartRowConstant (F.data κ).pressure.amp) →
                        Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialSeries F

        {M : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshData k N Sp} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsMeshData α c Sp M → Sort u} →
            ((gauge_specs :
                  ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsGaugeSpec (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).gaugeSpec) →
                (gauge_valid :
                    ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (M.coords K).layout.gauge ∧
                        (M.coords K).layout.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                          0 ≤ (M.coords K).layout.gauge.lo ∧
                            ((M.coords K).layout.gauge.radial = true →
                              (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level ≠ 0 ∧
                                0 ≤ min (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level (M.coords K).layout.gauge.other)) →
                  (gauge_canonical :
                      ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                        (M.coords K).gaugeLeft = M.canonicalLeft K ∧ (M.coords K).gaugeRight = M.canonicalRight K) →
                    (kappa_injective : Function.Injective Sp.kappaSlot) →
                      (kappa_unowned :
                          ∀ (a : Fin k) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                            (j :
                              Fin
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                    (M.coords K).param).card),
                            (M.coords K).Tmap j (Sp.kappaSlot a) = 0) →
                        (delay_injective : Function.Injective M.delaySlot) →
                          (delay_not_kappa : ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (a : Fin k), M.delaySlot j ≠ Sp.kappaSlot a) →
                            (delay_unowned :
                                ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                  (r :
                                    Fin
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                          (M.coords K).param).card),
                                  (M.coords K).Tmap r (M.delaySlot j) = 0) →
                              (expansion_base : ∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots), ∀ p ∈ M.delayExpansion i, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) →
                                (expansion_consistent :
                                    ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (l : Fin Sp.slots),
                                      ¬M.IsDelaySlot l →
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion (M.delaySlot j))
                                            l =
                                          (List.map
                                              (fun p =>
                                                p.2 *
                                                  if M.IsDelaySlot p.1 then
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion p.1)
                                                      l
                                                  else if p.1 = l then 1 else 0)
                                              (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                                  (delay_free :
                                      ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (i : Fin k),
                                        Sp.freeMap (M.delaySlot j) i =
                                          (List.map (fun p => p.2 * Sp.freeMap p.1 i) (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                                    (delay_form :
                                        ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount),
                                          Sp.delayForm j = Matrix.vecMulVec (M.delayVector j) (M.delayVector j)) →
                                      (rows :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                            (j :
                                              Fin
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords
                                                    (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).param).card),
                                            ∃ parts extra,
                                              (∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                                  (M.coords K).Tmap j i' =
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries parts i') ∧
                                                (∀ p ∈ parts, ∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ p.1) ∧
                                                  (∀ p ∈ parts, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) ∧
                                                    (∀ p ∈ parts,
                                                        (M.rowDatum (M.ownerCell p.1) (M.ownerRow p.1)).2 =
                                                          (M.rowDatum K j).2) ∧
                                                      (∀ e ∈ extra, (M.coords e.fst).layout.IsGaugeDeleted e.snd.1) ∧
                                                        ((extra = [] ∧
                                                              ∃ i,
                                                                parts = [(i, 1)] ∧
                                                                  M.rowKey K j = M.ownerKey i ∧
                                                                    (M.rowKey K j =
                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.private_ →
                                                                      M.ownerCell i = K ∧ M.ownerRow i ≍ j)) ∨
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SegmentSplit
                                                                (M.rowKey K j)
                                                                (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                                  M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.FluxSplit
                                                                  (M.rowKey K j)
                                                                  (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                                    M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                                parts = [] ∧
                                                                  extra = [] ∧ M.DeletedKey K j (M.rowKey K j)) ∧
                                                          ∀ u ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                            ∀ v ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                              u.1 = v.1 → u.2 = v.2) →
                                        (owner_row :
                                            ∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots),
                                              (∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ i) →
                                                ¬M.IsDelaySlot i →
                                                  ∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                                    (M.coords (M.ownerCell i)).Tmap (M.ownerRow i) i' =
                                                      if i' = i then 1 else 0) →
                                          (same_order : ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount), (M.coords K).layout.order = c.order) →
                                            (same_gauge :
                                                ∀ (K K' : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                  (M.coords K).layout.gauge = (M.coords K').layout.gauge) →
                                              (radial_segments :
                                                  ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                    ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).radial = true →
                                                      ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                                        0 ≤
                                                          min ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level
                                                            ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).other) →
                                                (radial_pressure_segments :
                                                    ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                      ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                                        ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                                          0 ≤
                                                            min ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level
                                                              ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →
                                                  (corners_valid :
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                                        (cr : Fin (M.coords K).layout.cornerCount),
                                                        ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                          ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1 ≠
                                                              ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ∧
                                                            ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).2 ≠
                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).2 ∧
                                                              0 ≤
                                                                min ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1
                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1) →
                                                    (segments_valid :
                                                        ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                          (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.segment s)) ∧
                                                            ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s)) →
                                                      (segments_nonneg :
                                                          ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                            (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                                0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).lo) ∧
                                                              ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                                0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).lo) →
                                                        (root_cells :
                                                            ∀ (cl : Fin M.classCount),
                                                              (M.classPath cl = [] ↔
                                                                  M.nodeClass (M.classRoot cl) (M.classRootSide cl) =
                                                                    cl) ∧
                                                                M.classRootDatum cl ∈
                                                                    (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).gaugeSpec.roots ∧
                                                                  (M.classRootSide cl = true →
                                                                      (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefRight
                                                                            (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠

                                                                        (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefLeft

                                                                            (M.classRootDatum cl) =

        {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds} →
          {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
              {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ} →
                {motive :
                    Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
                      Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio) →
                    ((ampW_ge :
                          ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                        (ampGradW_ge :
                            ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                  h.ampGradW β y) →
                          (ampVort_ge :
                              ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                        (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                    h.ampVort β y) →
                            (ampGradVort_ge :
                                ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                  ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                          (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                      h.ampGradVort β y) →
                              (supVort_ge :
                                  ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                                (supGradVort_ge :
                                    ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                        h.supGradVort y) →
                                  (epsSpeed_ge :
                                      ∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                              (m.epsP β).frame •
                                                (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                  (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                          (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                    (muSpeed_ge :
                                        ∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                (m.muP β).frame •
                                                  (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                    (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                            (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                      (eps_oneSided :
                                          ∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                            ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                              ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                                Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                        (mu_oneSided :
                                            ∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                              ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                  Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                          (mu_ratio :
                                              ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                    2 ≤
                                                  ratio *
                                                    ∑ β,
                                                      |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                        (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                            (ratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ ratio) →
                                              (eps_sum_le : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                                (eps_grad_sum_le :
                                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                                                  (conv_le :
                                                      ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                        m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                                    motive ⋯) →
                      motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X] →
      [inst_2 : CompleteSpace X] →
        (F : Breakdown.MildFramework X) →
          (rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X) →
            (∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R)) →
              (embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X) →
                (∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                    Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g) →
                  (∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                        ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2) →
                    (∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0) →
                      (∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                          Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)) →
                        (∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            0 < μ → Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)) →
                          (∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                              a < b →
                                (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                  ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                        ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                            MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                      (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                          Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                            (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                        (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                            Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                              ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                  (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                    Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                  t) →
                                          (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                            F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b) →
                            (test : Submodule ℝ X) →
                              Dense ↑test →
                                (∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x) → Breakdown.Realization X

                  0 ∨
                (sd.block (c.blockIndex a)).innerRadius = (sd.block (c.blockIndex b)).innerRadius ∧
                  (sd.block (c.blockIndex a)).outerRadius = (sd.block (c.blockIndex b)).outerRadius ∧
                    (sd.block (c.blockIndex a)).lowerHeight = (sd.block (c.blockIndex b)).lowerHeight ∧

          (∀ (a : Fin N),
