                Breakdown.CellCert.Spectral.AxisGradientBound (sd.block (c.blockIndex a)).degree
                  (sd.axisGradient (sd.block (c.blockIndex a)).degree)) →
            0 < c.cutoff →
              (∀ (a : Fin N), sd.tailFormula c.cutoff (c.blockIndex a) ≤ c.tailConst) →

declarations.type:
∀ {rowCount : ℕ} {M : Breakdown.CertCell.CellMesh} {R : Breakdown.CertCell.RowValues M.count rowCount} {m : ℕ}
  {tauMax : ℝ},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh M →
    0 < m →
      (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a ∈ M.tested (R.cellOf a)) →
        (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.testOf a < R.testCount (R.cellOf a) (R.labelOf a)) →
          (∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
              R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b →
                R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b → R.testOf a = R.testOf b → R.realPart a = R.realPart b → a = b) →
            (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, 0 < R.testWeight K ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K ι ≤ tauMax) →
                (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K (-ι) = R.testWeight K ι) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                        R.testCount K (-ι) = R.testCount K ι ∧
                          ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                            ∀ (c : Fin 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K (-ι) i c) p =
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K ι i c) p)) →
                    (∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                        R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b → R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf b → R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf a → R.realPart a = true) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                              ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                                ∀ (part : Bool),
                                  (ι = -ι → part = true) →
                                    ∃ a,
                                      R.cellOf a = K ∧
                                        (R.labelOf a = ι ∨ R.labelOf a = -ι) ∧ R.testOf a = i ∧ R.realPart a = part) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              ↑p.1 * deriv (fun r => R.testValue M.box a 0 (r, p.2)) p.1 + R.testValue M.box a 0 p +
                                    Complex.I * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth m (R.labelOf a)) *
                                      R.testValue M.box a 1 p +
                                  ↑p.1 * deriv (fun z => R.testValue M.box a 2 (p.1, z)) p.2 =
                                0) →
                            (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                (M.box (R.cellOf a)).IsAxis →
                                  p.1 = 0 → R.testValue M.box a 0 p = 0 ∧ R.testValue M.box a 1 p = 0) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, (R.testBlockMatrix M.box K ι).PosDef) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.IsRowValues M R m tauMax

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ProfileShapeEntry k}
  {Pr : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.PressureShapeEntry k}
  {Z : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.AdjointShapeEntry k}
  {O : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry k},
  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, 1 / D.cert.period q = O.freqCentre + ∑ i, q i * O.freqTangent i) →
    (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, ∀ (l : Fin k), D.cert.multiplier q l = O.multCentre l + ∑ i, q i * O.multTangent i l) →
      (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
          |O.offsetCentre j -
                (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multCentre l -
                  Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                    (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.centreCoefficient D R Pr O)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
            O.centreErr j) →
        (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
            ∀ (i : Fin k),
              |O.offsetLinear j i -
                    (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multTangent i l -
                      Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                        (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.linearCoefficient D R Pr O i)
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
                O.linearErr j i) →
          (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
              ∀ (i l : Fin k),
                i ≤ l →
                  |O.offsetQuad j i l +
                        Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                          (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.quadraticCoefficient R O i l)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j))| ≤
                    O.quadErr j i l) →
            0 ≤ O.farDefect →
              (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet, 0 ≤ O.farAdjoint j) →
                (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                        if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then ‖D.cert.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
                      ENNReal.ofReal (O.farDefect ^ 2)) →
                  (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                      (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                          if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then
                            ‖Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j) σ y‖ ^ 2
                          else 0) ≤
                        ENNReal.ofReal (O.farAdjoint j ^ 2)) →
                    (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                        D.cert.adjointOffset j = Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.offsetSum D.cert O j) →
                      Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.IsOffsetExpansionEntry D R Pr Z O

              {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesRealNodeEnclosure T ν D E F → Sort u} →

                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue D.input x ≤
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x +
                              Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i => |x i|) →
                      (input_symm : D.input.transpose = D.input) →
                        (base_symm : D.base.transpose = D.base) →
                          (weight_pos : ∀ (j : A ⊕ B), 0 < D.weight j) →
                            (input_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ E i j) →
                              (input_error_symm : E.transpose = E) →
                                (front_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                                  (front_error_symm : F.transpose = F) →
                                    (row_bound :
                                        ∀ (i : A ⊕ B),
                                          D.weight i *
                                              ∑ j,
                                                (|Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.slackRemainder D.input D.base
                                                          (T.pivots ν) D.pivotValue D.posColumns (T.nodeColumns ν) i
                                                          j| +

                                                      (Finset.univ \ T.pivots ν) D.radius)
                                                  x +

∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {P : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ProfileShapeEntry k} {N : Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.ShiftNumbers},

            (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖P.field q σ y - P.field 0 σ y‖ ≤ N.boxSup) →
              (∀ (σ : ℝ),
                  ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => P.field 0 σ x - D.given σ x) y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                    ENNReal.ofReal (N.centreGrad ^ 2)) →
                (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                    ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                      ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => P.field q σ x - P.field 0 σ x) y‖ ^ 3) ≤
                        ENNReal.ofReal (N.boxGrad ^ 3)) →
                  Breakdown.CertReduction.gapGradCoeff D.cert.weight false * N.centreGrad +
                          N.centreSup / √D.cert.weight +
                        (Breakdown.CertReduction.gapGradCoeff D.cert.weight true * N.boxGrad +
                          N.boxSup / √D.cert.weight) ≤

                            N.centreSup / (2 * √D.cert.weight) +

                      Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.ShiftNumbersBounded D P N

declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {Q : Fin D.mesh.count → Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingData k} →
              {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S → Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S) →
                    ((mesh_valid : Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh) →
                        (cell_conditions : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R) →
                          (kept_le :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                S K x →
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
                            (source_eq :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                      S K x →
                                        ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                          ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec
                                                (fun a b =>
                                                  1 / 2 *
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                                                0) →
                              (source_zero :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                      ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                                        ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                          S K x →
                                            ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x
                                                  p =
                                                0) →
                                (gamma_resolved :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                                          (∃ g a b,
                                              ¬(fun p =>
                                                    R.pairProfile K g ι p a
                                                      b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                                  0) →
                                            ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                                              0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                                (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                                                  ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                    (∑ a,
                                                        ∑ b,
                                                          (D.mesh.box K).tailNormSq ((R.layouts K).layout ι).degCoef
                                                            fun p =>
                                                            ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat
                                                                  (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                                (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>
                                                        ↑(w g)) →
                                  (gamma_other :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                                          ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                                            ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                              (∃ g a b,
                                                  ¬(fun p =>
                                                        R.pairProfile K g ι p a
                                                          b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                                      0) →
                                                ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                                                  ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes ∧
                                                    0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                                      (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧
                                                        ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                              p.1 *
                                                                ∑ a,
                                                                  ∑ b,
                                                                    ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                                          (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b‖ ^
                                                                      2 ≤
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι)
                                                              fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                                    (gamma_gram :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                                            0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                              ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                0 ≤
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>
                                                    ↑(w g)) →
                                      (leak_nonneg :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι) →
                                        (cost_nonneg :
                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                              0 ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι) →
                                          motive ⋯) →
                      motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W) →
              ((resolved_eq : S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                  (band_eq : S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                    (energy_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
                      (vorticity_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
                        (shift_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
                          (curl_form :
                              ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                S.curlAbsorb n =
                                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl
                                  else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
                            (strain_form :
                                ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                                    else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                              (velocity_form :
                                  ∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                                (sym_form :
                                    ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                      S.symWeight n j l =
                                        S.energyWeight n *
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                K.angularWeight n *
                                                  max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^
                                                    2) -
                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                  (anti_form :
                                      ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                        S.antiWeight n j l =
                                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                                      max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^
                                                        2) -
                                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                                            S.tailShift n) →
                                    (vel_form :
                                        ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                          S.velWeight n j l =
                                            (S.tailShift n *
                                                if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                                else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                                              S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                      motive ⋯) →
                motive t

                        (radius_nonneg : ∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →

                                                  (formScale_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formScale) →
                                                    (formScale_bound :
                                                        ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.recOn
declarations.type:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X] →
      [inst_2 : CompleteSpace X] →
        {motive : Breakdown.Realization X → Sort u} →
          (t : Breakdown.Realization X) →
            ((F : Breakdown.MildFramework X) →
                (rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X) →
                  (rot_commutes : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R)) →
                    (embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X) →
                      (embed_sub :
                          ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g) →
                        (embed_norm :
                            ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                              Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 =
                                  ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2) →
                          (embed_ne_zero :
                              ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0) →
                            (embed_rot :
                                ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                  Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)) →
                              (embed_dilate :
                                  ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                    0 < μ →
                                      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                        (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)) →
                                (mild_of_weak :
                                    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                                      a < b →
                                        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                                    MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                  Filter.Tendsto
                                                    (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                                    (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                            Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                          t) →
                                                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                        ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                          (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                                    F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b) →
                                  (test : Submodule ℝ X) →
                                    (test_dense : Dense ↑test) →
                                      (test_spec : ∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x) →
                                        motive
                                          { F := F, rot := rot, rot_commutes := rot_commutes, embed := embed,
                                            embed_sub := embed_sub, embed_norm := embed_norm,
                                            embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero, embed_rot := embed_rot,
                                            embed_dilate := embed_dilate, mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak, test := test,
                                            test_dense := test_dense, test_spec := test_spec }) →
              motive t

                                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField
                                                                                    c.order (r.classes.modes i)

            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c K S W → Sort u} →
              (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c K S W) →
                ((order_ge : 3 ≤ c.order) →
                    (energy_pos : 0 < W.energy) →
                      (energy_le : W.energy ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                        (vorticity_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.vorticity) →
                          (vorticity_le : W.vorticity ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                            (shift_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.shift) →

                                          W.rLo ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ∧

                                    (mean_le :

                                            2 * W.meanConst) →
                                      (wave_le :
                                          ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.waveGradBound p ≤
                                              2 * W.waveConst) →
                                        (lam_le : ∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.strainBound p ≤ W.lamMax) →
                                          (weight_le :
                                              ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sampleWeight c p ≤
                                                  W.weightMax) →
                                            (splitLength_pos : 0 < S.splitLength) →
                                              (consts_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ W.waveConst ∧ 0 ≤ c.coercivity) →
                                                (penalties_nonneg :
                                                    0 ≤ S.penaltyStrain ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyCurl ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyVelocity) →
                                                  (curl_band_ge :
                                                      max (W.rLo * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                                          (W.rHi * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                                        W.curlBand) →
                                                    (curl_out_ge :
                                                        max
                                                            (W.rLo *
                                                              (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl -
                                                                (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                                            (W.rHi *
                                                              (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl -
                                                                (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                                          W.curlOut) →
                                                      (strain_base_ge :
                                                          max
                                                              (W.rLo *
                                                                (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                  (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax)))
                                                              (W.rHi *
                                                                (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                  (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax))) ≤
                                                            W.strainBase) →
                                                        (strain_quad_ge :
                                                            W.rHi * W.waveConst / S.splitLength ≤ W.strainQuad) →
                                                          (sym_resolved_radial :
                                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                W.energy *
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                        K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                                    W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                  W.shift) →
                                                            (sym_resolved_height :
                                                                S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                  W.energy *
                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                          K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                      W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                    W.shift) →
                                                              (anti_resolved_radial :
                                                                  S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                    (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                              K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                                          2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                                        W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                      W.shift) →
                                                                (anti_resolved_height :
                                                                    S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                      (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                                K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                            2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                                          W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                        W.shift) →
                                                                  (sym_band :

                                                                        W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order) true) →
                                                                    (sym_out :
                                                                        S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                          W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order)
                                                                            false) →
                                                                      (anti_band :
                                                                          S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                            W.antiAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order)
                                                                              true) →
                                                                        (anti_out :
                                                                            S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                              W.antiAt K S 0 0
                                                                                (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false) →
                                                                          (vel_radial :
                                                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                                W.shift *
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen
                                                                                      K S.degHigh -
                                                                                  W.resolvedVelocity) →

  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData},

                        W.rLo ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ∧
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ≤ W.rHi) →
                    (∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.meanGradBound p ≤ 2 * W.meanConst) →
                      (∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.waveGradBound p ≤ 2 * W.waveConst) →
                        (∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.strainBound p ≤ W.lamMax) →
                          (∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sampleWeight c p ≤ W.weightMax) →
                            0 < S.splitLength →
                              0 ≤ W.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ W.waveConst ∧ 0 ≤ c.coercivity →
                                0 ≤ S.penaltyStrain ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyCurl ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyVelocity →
                                  max (W.rLo * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                        (W.rHi * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                      W.curlBand →
                                    max (W.rLo * (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                          (W.rHi * (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                        W.curlOut →
                                      max
                                            (W.rLo *
                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax)))
                                            (W.rHi *
                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax))) ≤
                                          W.strainBase →
                                        W.rHi * W.waveConst / S.splitLength ≤ W.strainQuad →
                                          S.weightFloor ≤
                                              W.energy *
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K
                                                      (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                  W.resolvedStrain -
                                                W.shift →
                                            S.weightFloor ≤

                                                        2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                      W.resolvedStrain -
                                                    W.shift →
                                                S.weightFloor ≤
                                                    (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K 0
                                                              (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                          2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                        W.resolvedStrain -
                                                      W.shift →
                                                  S.weightFloor ≤ W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order) true →
                                                    S.weightFloor ≤
                                                        W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false →
